AI.title_translation: 停止推挤：自适应负采样减少交叉熵损失对低资源语言标记的边缘化
AI.tldr: 针对低资源语言标记在训练中被过度边缘化的问题，本文提出了一种基于阈值的自适应负采样技术，显著提高了字符级语言模型在低资源数据上的表现。
AI.motivation: 神经语言模型因训练数据有限而难以处理低资源语言，导致训练集中的稀有标记受到不成比例的边缘化影响，进而阻碍了它们的有效学习。
AI.method: 提出了一种阈值技术（thresholding technique），用于减少交叉熵损失对稀有标记的边缘化影响，使稀有标记能够从更有意义的对齐中受益。
AI.result: 通过字符级语言模型的实验证明，该方法显著提高了在低资源语言验证数据上的性能。
AI.conclusion: 本工作首次展示了如何通过限制过度边缘化的有害影响来应用负采样以改善稀有标记的表示，为增强弱势语言的语言模型性能提供了一种新方法。
AI.translation: 神经语言模型通常由于训练数据的有限性而难以处理低资源语言，使得这些语言的标记在训练集中变得稀有。本文解决了一个特定的训练挑战：稀有标记受到不成比例的边缘化影响，这阻碍了它们的有效学习。我们提出了一种阈值技术来减少这种边缘化的影响，使稀有标记能够从更有意义的对齐中受益。通过对字符级语言模型的实验，我们证明了该方法显著提高了在低资源语言验证数据上的性能。这项工作首次展示了如何通过限制过度边缘化的有害影响来应用负采样以改善稀有标记的表示，为增强弱势语言的语言模型性能提供了一种新方法。
AI.summary: 鉴于低资源语言标记在训练中因数据稀缺而遭受过度边缘化，本文提出了一种自适应的阈值技术，以减轻边缘化对稀有标记学习的负面影响。实验证明，该方法在字符级语言模型上显著提升了低资源语言的性能，并开创了利用负采样来改善稀有标记表示的新途径。
AI.keywords: 自适应负采样, 低资源语言, 边缘化, 稀有标记, 字符级语言模型
AI.comments: 本文创新点在于将负采样（Negative Sampling）这一技术应用于解决交叉熵损失对低资源语言（即稀有标记）造成的过度边缘化问题。这种方法通过自适应地限制边缘化，使得模型能够对稀有但重要的标记进行更有效的学习和对齐。它为提升处理数据不平衡和低资源场景下的语言模型性能提供了一个新的、实用的优化方向。

title: AI and My Values: User Perceptions of LLMs' Ability to Extract, Embody, and Explain Human Values from Casual Conversations
summary: Does AI understand human values? While this remains an open philosophical question, we take a pragmatic stance by introducing VAPT, the Value-Alignment Perception Toolkit, for studying how LLMs reflect people's values and how people judge those reflections. 20 participants texted a human-like chatbot over a month, then completed a 2-hour interview with our toolkit evaluating AI's ability to extract (pull details regarding), embody (make decisions guided by), and explain (provide proof of) human values. 13 participants left our study convinced that AI can understand human values. Participants found the experience insightful for self-reflection and found themselves getting persuaded by the AI's reasoning. Thus, we warn about "weaponized empathy": a potentially dangerous design pattern that may arise in value-aligned, yet welfare-misaligned AI. VAPT offers concrete artifacts and design implications to evaluate and responsibly build value-aligned conversational agents with transparency, consent, and safeguards as AI grows more capable and human-like into the future.

AI.title_translation: AI与我的价值观：用户对大型语言模型从日常对话中提取、体现和解释人类价值观能力的感知
AI.tldr: 研究引入VAPT工具包，测试用户对LLM理解人类价值观的感知。大多数参与者相信AI能理解价值观，但研究警告了“武器化同理心”的风险，并呼吁在设计中加入保障措施。
AI.motivation: 探讨AI是否理解人类价值观这一哲学问题，并采取务实立场研究LLM如何反映人们的价值观以及人们如何评判这些反映。
AI.method: 引入了VAPT（价值观对齐感知工具包）。20名参与者与一个人形聊天机器人进行了一个月的短信交流，随后进行了2小时的访谈，使用VAPT评估AI提取、体现和解释人类价值观的能力。
AI.result: 20名参与者中有13人确信AI能够理解人类价值观。参与者认为这次体验有助于自我反思，并发现自己被AI的推理所说服。
AI.conclusion: 研究警告了“武器化同理心”的风险，这是一种可能出现在价值观对齐但福利未对齐的AI中的潜在危险设计模式。VAPT为负责任地构建价值观对齐的对话代理提供了具体的工件和设计启示，强调透明度、同意和保障措施。
AI.translation: 尽管“AI是否理解人类价值观？”仍是一个开放的哲学问题，但我们采取了一种务实的立场，引入了VAPT（价值观对齐感知工具包），用于研究大型语言模型（LLMs）如何反映人们的价值观以及人们如何评判这些反映。20名参与者在一个月内与一个类人聊天机器人进行短信交流，随后完成了长达2小时的访谈，使用我们的工具包评估AI提取（拉取相关细节）、体现（在指导下做出决定）和解释（提供证明）人类价值观的能力。13名参与者在研究结束后确信AI能够理解人类价值观。参与者发现这次经历对自我反思很有启发性，并且发现自己被AI的推理所说服。因此，我们对“武器化同理心”发出了警告：这是一种可能出现在价值观对齐但福利未对齐的AI中的潜在危险设计模式。随着AI在未来变得更加强大和类人化，VAPT提供了具体的工件和设计启示，用于评估和负责任地构建具有透明度、同意和保障措施的价值观对齐对话代理。
AI.summary: 本研究引入VAPT工具包，务实地评估用户对大型语言模型（LLMs）在长期互动后提取、体现和解释人类价值观能力的感知。大多数参与者相信AI能够理解价值观，这导致了自我反思和被AI说服。研究强调了“武器化同理心”的风险，并为构建负责任的、价值观对齐的对话代理提供了设计指南。
AI.keywords: AI, 人类价值观, LLMs, 价值观对齐, 武器化同理心
AI.comments: 本研究的创新在于提出了VAPT工具包，并首次结构化地评估了用户对LLM价值观理解的感知（提取、体现、解释）。其重要性在于对“武器化同理心”这一潜在伦理风险的明确警告，这对于未来高拟人化和高说服力的AI设计至关重要。研究结果揭示了AI的说服力可能超越用户的预期，促使设计者在追求价值对齐的同时，必须加入透明度和保障措施。

title: AsyncMesh: Fully Asynchronous Optimization for Data and Pipeline Parallelism
summary: Data and pipeline parallelism are key strategies for scaling neural network training across distributed devices, but their high communication cost necessitates co-located computing clusters with fast interconnects, limiting their scalability. We address this communication bottleneck by introducing asynchronous updates across both parallelism axes, relaxing the co-location requirement at the expense of introducing staleness between pipeline stages and data parallel replicas. To mitigate staleness, for pipeline parallelism, we adopt a weight look-ahead approach, and for data parallelism, we introduce an asynchronous sparse averaging method equipped with an exponential moving average based correction mechanism. We provide convergence guarantees for both sparse averaging and asynchronous updates. Experiments on large-scale language models (up to \em 1B parameters) demonstrate that our approach matches the performance of the fully synchronous baseline, while significantly reducing communication overhead.

AI.title_translation: AsyncMesh：用于数据和流水线并行化的完全异步优化
AI.tldr: AsyncMesh通过在数据和流水线并行化中引入完全异步更新，解决了传统同步方法的高通信成本和共址要求。它使用权重前瞻和稀疏平均与EMA校正来缓解陈旧性，并在大规模模型上实现了与同步基线相当的性能，同时显著减少了通信开销。
AI.motivation: 传统的数据和流水线并行化策略通信成本高昂，需要快速互连的共址计算集群，从而限制了它们的可扩展性。
AI.method: 引入了跨数据和流水线并行轴的完全异步更新，以放松共址要求（代价是引入陈旧性）。为缓解陈旧性，对于流水线并行化，采用权重前瞻方法；对于数据并行化，引入了配备基于指数移动平均（EMA）校正机制的异步稀疏平均方法。同时提供了稀疏平均和异步更新的收敛性保证。
AI.result: 在高达10亿参数的大规模语言模型上的实验表明，该方法在显著减少通信开销的同时，性能与完全同步的基线相匹配。
AI.conclusion: 异步优化方法AsyncMesh成功地克服了分布式训练中的通信瓶颈，实现了与同步方法相当的性能和收敛性保证，同时提高了系统的可扩展性和灵活性。
AI.translation: 数据和流水线并行化是跨分布式设备扩展神经网络训练的关键策略，但其高昂的通信成本需要具有快速互连的共址计算集群，从而限制了它们的可扩展性。我们通过在两个并行轴上引入异步更新来解决这一通信瓶颈，以引入流水线阶段和数据并行副本之间的陈旧性为代价，放松了共址要求。为了减轻陈旧性，对于流水线并行化，我们采用了权重前瞻方法；对于数据并行化，我们引入了一种配备基于指数移动平均（EMA）校正机制的异步稀疏平均方法。我们为稀疏平均和异步更新提供了收敛性保证。在大型语言模型（高达10亿参数）上的实验表明，我们的方法在显著减少通信开销的同时，性能与完全同步的基线相匹配。
AI.summary: 本文提出了AsyncMesh，一种用于数据和流水线并行化的完全异步优化方法，旨在解决同步分布式训练中高通信成本和严格的共址要求。AsyncMesh通过在两个并行轴上引入异步更新来放松共址限制，并通过权重前瞻（针对流水线并行）和配备EMA校正机制的异步稀疏平均（针对数据并行）来应对由此产生的陈旧性问题。该方法提供了收敛性保证，并在高达10亿参数的大型模型上被证明可以显著减少通信开销，同时保持与同步基线一致的性能。
AI.keywords: 异步优化, 数据并行化, 流水线并行化, 通信开销, 稀疏平均
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于将异步更新策略同时应用于数据并行化和流水线并行化这两个关键的分布式训练维度，从而有效地解决了同步训练中对快速互连和共址集群的严格依赖。通过引入特定的机制（权重前瞻和带EMA校正的稀疏平均）来系统地缓解异步引入的梯度陈旧性问题，使得该方法在大规模模型上依然能保持高性能，极大地提高了分布式训练的可扩展性和灵活性。

title: Weak Diffusion Priors Can Still Achieve Strong Inverse-Problem Performance
summary: Can a diffusion model trained on bedrooms recover human faces? Diffusion models are widely used as priors for inverse problems, but standard approaches usually assume a high-fidelity model trained on data that closely match the unknown signal. In practice, one often must use a mismatched or low-fidelity diffusion prior. Surprisingly, these weak priors often perform nearly as well as full-strength, in-domain baselines. We study when and why inverse solvers are robust to weak diffusion priors. Through extensive experiments, we find that weak priors succeed when measurements are highly informative (e.g., many observed pixels), and we identify regimes where they fail. Our theory, based on Bayesian consistency, gives conditions under which high-dimensional measurements make the posterior concentrate near the true signal. These results provide a principled justification on when weak diffusion priors can be used reliably.

AI.title_translation: 弱扩散先验仍能实现强大的逆问题性能
AI.tldr: 即使是与目标数据不匹配或低保真度的扩散模型（弱先验），在逆问题求解中也能表现出色，尤其是在测量信息量大时。本文通过实验和贝叶斯一致性理论，解释了这种鲁棒性的原因，并提供了可靠使用弱先验的条件。
AI.motivation: 扩散模型通常被用作逆问题的先验，但标准方法要求使用与未知信号高度匹配的高保真模型。本文的动机是研究在实践中经常必须使用的不匹配或低保真度的“弱扩散先验”为何能表现出色，并探究逆问题求解器何时以及为何对它们具有鲁棒性。
AI.method: 采用了广泛的实验研究，并结合了基于贝叶斯一致性（Bayesian consistency）的理论分析。
AI.result: 实验发现，当测量信息量大（例如，观察到的像素多）时，弱先验能够成功，并且性能出人意料地与全强度、域内基线接近。理论上，基于贝叶斯一致性，结果给出了在高维测量下后验分布集中于真实信号附近的条件。
AI.conclusion: 结果为弱扩散先验何时可以可靠使用提供了原理性的依据/证明。
AI.translation: 经过卧室数据训练的扩散模型能否恢复人脸？扩散模型被广泛用作逆问题的先验，但标准方法通常假设使用一个经过与未知信号高度匹配的数据训练的高保真模型。在实践中，人们经常必须使用不匹配或低保真度的扩散先验。令人惊讶的是，这些弱先验的表现往往与全强度、域内基线几乎一样好。我们研究了逆问题求解器何时以及为何对弱扩散先验具有鲁棒性。通过广泛的实验，我们发现当测量信息量大（例如，观察到的像素多）时，弱先验会成功，并且我们确定了它们失败的范围。我们基于贝叶斯一致性的理论，给出了高维测量使后验分布集中在真实信号附近的条件。这些结果为弱扩散先验何时可以可靠使用提供了原理性的依据。
AI.summary: 本文研究了在逆问题中使用不匹配或低保真度（弱）扩散先验的有效性。尽管标准方法要求高保真匹配先验，但实验发现，弱先验的性能出人意料地接近域内强先验。通过实验和基于贝叶斯一致性的理论分析，研究确定了弱先验成功的关键在于测量数据的信息量大小（即高维测量）。研究结果为在特定条件下可靠地应用弱扩散先验提供了理论支持。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 逆问题, 弱先验, 贝叶斯一致性, 高维测量
AI.comments: 本文的关键创新在于挑战了扩散模型作为逆问题先验时必须是高保真且域内匹配的传统假设。它通过系统的实验和理论分析（特别是基于贝叶斯一致性）为在数据获取成本高或领域数据稀缺的实际场景中，使用通用或不匹配的预训练扩散模型提供了强大的理论和实践依据。这一发现极大地拓宽了扩散模型在实际逆问题应用中的适用性。

title: Automating Forecasting Question Generation and Resolution for AI Evaluation
summary: Forecasting future events is highly valuable in decision-making and is a robust measure of general intelligence. As forecasting is probabilistic, developing and evaluating AI forecasters requires generating large numbers of diverse and difficult questions, and accurately resolving them. Previous efforts to automate this laborious work relied on recurring data sources (e.g., weather, stocks), limiting diversity and utility. In this work, we present a system for generating and resolving high-quality forecasting questions automatically and at scale using LLM-powered web research agents. We use this system to generate 1499 diverse, real-world forecasting questions, and to resolve them several months later. We estimate that our system produces verifiable, unambiguous questions approximately 96% of the time, exceeding the rate of Metaculus, a leading human-curated forecasting platform. We also find that our system resolves questions at approximately 95% accuracy. We verify that forecasting agents powered by more intelligent LLMs perform better on these questions (Brier score of 0.134 for Gemini 3 Pro, 0.149 for GPT-5, and 0.179 for Gemini 2.5 Flash). Finally, we demonstrate how our system can be leveraged to directly improve forecasting, by evaluating a question decomposition strategy on a generated question set, yielding a significant improvement in Brier scores (0.132 vs. 0.141).

AI.title_translation: 自动化预测问题生成与解决用于AI评估
AI.tldr: 使用基于LLM的网络研究代理，我们创建了一个系统，可以自动生成和解决大量高质量的现实世界预测问题（共1499个）。该系统在问题质量和解决准确性上均优于人工平台，并且可用于验证更强大的LLM在预测中表现更好，并帮助改进预测策略。
AI.motivation: 预测未来事件对决策制定和衡量通用智能非常重要。开发和评估AI预测器需要大量多样化、困难的问题及准确的解决（验证）。以前的自动化方法依赖重复数据源（如天气、股票），限制了多样性和实用性和规模。
AI.method: 提出了一个利用LLM驱动的网络研究代理（web research agents）自动且大规模生成和解决高质量预测问题的系统。
AI.result: 系统生成了1499个多样化的现实世界预测问题。问题可验证、无歧义的比例约为96%（高于Metaculus）。问题解决准确率约为95%。发现更智能的LLM预测代理表现更好（Gemini 3 Pro的Brier得分为0.134，优于GPT-5的0.149和Gemini 2.5 Flash的0.179）。系统还通过评估问题分解策略，显著改善了Brier得分（0.132对0.141）。
AI.conclusion: 该系统能够大规模、高质量地自动化生成和解决预测问题，其准确性和问题质量均超过现有领先的人工平台。此外，该系统可用于评估和直接改进AI预测策略。
AI.translation: 预测未来事件在决策制定中具有极高价值，是衡量通用智能的有力标准。由于预测是概率性的，开发和评估AI预测器需要生成大量多样化且困难的问题，并准确地解决（验证）这些问题。此前旨在自动化这项繁重工作的方法依赖于重复性数据源（例如天气、股票），限制了问题多样性和实用性。在本文中，我们提出了一个系统，该系统利用LLM驱动的网络研究代理，能够自动且大规模地生成和解决高质量的预测问题。我们使用该系统生成了1499个多样化的现实世界预测问题，并在几个月后对它们进行解决。我们估计，我们的系统生成可验证、无歧义问题的比例约为96%，超过了领先的人工策划预测平台Metaculus的比例。我们还发现，我们的系统解决问题的准确率约为95%。我们验证了由更智能的LLM驱动的预测代理在这些问题上表现更佳（Gemini 3 Pro的Brier得分为0.134，GPT-5为0.149，Gemini 2.5 Flash为0.179）。最后，我们展示了如何利用我们的系统直接改进预测，通过在一组生成的问题上评估问题分解策略，从而显著改善了Brier得分（0.132 对 0.141）。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个利用LLM驱动的网络研究代理系统，用于自动化、大规模地生成和解决高质量、多样化的现实世界预测问题，以评估AI预测能力。该系统生成了1499个问题，验证了其在问题质量（96%可验证）和解决准确性（95%）上优于人工平台。实验结果显示，更先进的LLM（如Gemini 3 Pro）在这些问题上的预测表现更优，并且该系统可用于评估和改进预测策略（如问题分解）。
AI.keywords: 预测问题生成,LLM代理,AI评估,问题解决,Brier分数
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于利用LLM和网络研究代理实现了预测问题生成和验证的端到端自动化，解决了传统方法依赖重复数据源、缺乏多样性的问题。其重要性体现在为AI通用智能的评估提供了一个高质量、可扩展的基准测试方法，特别是通过生成比现有领先人工平台更高质量的问题集（96%可验证）。此外，它提供了一个直接改进AI预测策略（如问题分解）的工具，对提升AI在决策制定中的实用性具有重要意义。

title: High-Definition 5MP Stereo Vision Sensing for Robotics
summary: High-resolution (5MP+) stereo vision systems are essential for advancing robotic capabilities, enabling operation over longer ranges and generating significantly denser and accurate 3D point clouds. However, realizing the full potential of high-angular-resolution sensors requires a commensurately higher level of calibration accuracy and faster processing -- requirements often unmet by conventional methods. This study addresses that critical gap by processing 5MP camera imagery using a novel, advanced frame-to-frame calibration and stereo matching methodology designed to achieve both high accuracy and speed. Furthermore, we introduce a new approach to evaluate real-time performance by comparing real-time disparity maps with ground-truth disparity maps derived from more computationally intensive stereo matching algorithms. Crucially, the research demonstrates that high-pixel-count cameras yield high-quality point clouds only through the implementation of high-accuracy calibration.

AI.title_translation: 机器人应用的高清500万像素立体视觉传感
AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新颖的校准和立体匹配方法，以实现机器人用高清（5MP）立体视觉的高精度和高速度处理，并证明高精度校准对于生成高质量点云至关重要。
AI.motivation: 促进机器人能力发展需要高分辨率（5MP+）立体视觉系统，以实现更长距离操作和生成更密集、更准确的3D点云。然而，现有方法无法满足高分辨率传感器所需的相应高精度校准和快速处理要求。
AI.method: 采用一种新颖、先进的帧间校准和立体匹配方法来处理5MP相机图像，以实现高精度和高速处理。此外，引入了一种新的实时性能评估方法，即将实时视差图与计算密集型立体匹配算法得出的地面真实视差图进行比较。
AI.result: 研究证明，高像素相机只有通过实施高精度校准才能生成高质量的点云。
AI.conclusion: 高分辨率立体视觉系统若要充分发挥潜力，必须采用高精度校准方法。
AI.translation: 高分辨率（5MP+）立体视觉系统对于提升机器人能力至关重要，它能实现更长距离的操作，并生成明显更密集、更准确的3D点云。然而，要充分发挥高角分辨率传感器的潜力，需要相应更高水平的校准精度和更快的处理速度——这些要求往往是传统方法无法满足的。本研究通过使用一种旨在实现高精度和高速的新颖、先进的帧间校准和立体匹配方法来处理5MP相机图像，解决了这一关键差距。此外，我们引入了一种新的方法来评估实时性能，即通过将实时视差图与源自计算密集型立体匹配算法的地面真实视差图进行比较。至关重要的是，研究表明，高像素相机只有通过实施高精度校准才能产生高质量的点云。
AI.summary: 针对机器人应用中高分辨率（5MP+）立体视觉系统对高精度校准和快速处理的需求未被满足的问题，本文提出了一种新颖的帧间校准和立体匹配方法来处理5MP图像。该研究还引入了一种新的实时性能评估机制。核心发现是，高像素相机必须依赖高精度校准才能生成高质量的3D点云，从而为机器人提供更先进的感知能力。
AI.keywords: 立体视觉, 机器人技术, 高清传感, 校准, 3D点云
AI.comments: 本文的重要性在于它直接解决了高分辨率（5MP+）立体视觉传感器在机器人领域应用中的核心瓶颈——即校准精度和处理速度。通过引入新颖的帧间校准和立体匹配方法，该研究使机器人能够利用高像素相机生成更密集、更准确的3D点云。特别值得注意的是，研究强调了“高精度校准”是释放高分辨率传感器潜力的必要条件，这对于未来设计和部署先进的立体视觉系统具有重要的指导意义。

title: Anytime Safe PAC Efficient Reasoning
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have demonstrated remarkable performance on complex tasks but suffer from high computational costs and latency. While selective thinking strategies improve efficiency by routing easy queries to non-thinking models, existing approaches often incur uncontrollable errors, especially in online settings where the performance loss of a non-thinking model is only partially observed and data are non-stationary. To address this, we propose Betting Probably Approximately Correct (B-PAC) reasoning, a principled method that enables anytime safe and efficient online reasoning under partial feedback. Specifically, we utilize inverse propensity scoring estimators to construct test supermartingales for candidate thresholds, and then dynamically adjust the routing threshold based on the accumulated statistical evidence of safety. Theoretically, we establish the anytime-valid performance loss control and the efficiency of B-PAC reasoning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that B-PAC reasoning significantly reduces computational overhead, decreasing thinking model usage by up to 81.01\%, while controlling the performance loss below the user-specified level.

AI.tldr: 针对大型推理模型成本高和现有选择性策略错误不可控的问题，本文提出了B-PAC推理方法。该方法利用统计证据动态调整路由阈值，实现了在部分反馈下的随时安全且高效的在线推理，可将昂贵模型的使用率降低高达81.01\%，同时保证性能不低于设定水平。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）虽然性能卓越，但计算成本高昂且延迟大。现有的选择性思考策略在在线设置中由于仅能部分观测性能损失且数据非平稳，导致错误不可控。
AI.method: 提出“押注可能近似正确（B-PAC）推理”方法。该方法利用逆倾向得分估计器构建候选阈值的测试上鞅（test supermartingales），并根据累积的安全统计证据动态调整查询的路由阈值，以实现随时安全高效的在线推理。
AI.result: 理论上，确立了B-PAC推理的随时有效性能损失控制和效率。实验证明，B-PAC推理显著降低了计算开销，将思考模型的使用率降低了高达81.01\%，同时将性能损失控制在用户指定的水平以下。
AI.conclusion: B-PAC推理是一种在部分反馈下实现随时安全且高效在线推理的原则性方法，它通过动态调整路由阈值，在保证性能损失可控的前提下，大幅提高了效率。
AI.translation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在复杂任务上表现出色，但计算成本高且延迟大。虽然选择性思考策略通过将简单查询路由到非思考模型来提高效率，但现有方法通常会产生不可控的错误，尤其是在线设置中，因为非思考模型的性能损失仅能被部分观测且数据是非平稳的。为解决此问题，我们提出了押注可能近似正确（B-PAC）推理，这是一种原则性的方法，能够在部分反馈下实现随时安全和高效的在线推理。具体来说，我们利用逆倾向得分估计器构建候选阈值的测试上鞅，然后根据累积的安全统计证据动态调整路由阈值。在理论上，我们确立了B-PAC推理的随时有效性能损失控制和效率。广泛的实验表明，B-PAC推理显著减少了计算开销，将思考模型的使用率降低了高达81.01\%，同时将性能损失控制在用户指定的水平以下。
AI.summary: 本文针对大型推理模型（LRMs）的高成本问题，提出了“押注可能近似正确（B-PAC）推理”方法。该方法旨在解决现有选择性思考策略在在线、部分反馈及非平稳数据环境中错误不可控的局限性。B-PAC利用逆倾向得分估计器构建测试上鞅，并根据累积的统计证据动态调整查询路由阈值，从而在理论上保证了随时有效的性能损失控制和效率。实验结果显示，B-PAC在将性能损失控制在用户指定水平的同时，将昂贵模型的计算开销降低了高达81.01\%。
AI.keywords: 随时安全, PAC推理, 在线推理, 效率, 性能损失控制
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将统计控制理论（通过构建测试上鞅）引入到在线推理模型的路由决策中，解决了现有“选择性思考”策略在实际在线部署中面临的核心挑战——即在部分观测和非平稳数据下如何保证错误率的安全可控。B-PAC方法提供了严格的理论保证（随时有效的性能损失控制），并展示了巨大的实际效率提升（高达81.01\%的昂贵模型使用率降低），这对于大规模部署高效且可靠的AI推理系统具有重要意义。

title: Beyond Activation Patterns: A Weight-Based Out-of-Context Explanation of Sparse Autoencoder Features
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) have emerged as a powerful technique for decomposing language model representations into interpretable features. Current interpretation methods infer feature semantics from activation patterns, but overlook that features are trained to reconstruct activations that serve computational roles in the forward pass. We introduce a novel weight-based interpretation framework that measures functional effects through direct weight interactions, requiring no activation data. Through three experiments on Gemma-2 and Llama-3.1 models, we demonstrate that (1) 1/4 of features directly predict output tokens, (2) features actively participate in attention mechanisms with depth-dependent structure, and (3) semantic and non-semantic feature populations exhibit distinct distribution profiles in attention circuits. Our analysis provides the missing out-of-context half of SAE feature interpretability.

AI.title_translation: 超越激活模式：稀疏自编码器特征的基于权重的脱离上下文解释
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的基于权重的框架来解释稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的功能，该框架无需激活数据，并揭示了SAE特征如何直接预测输出以及参与语言模型的注意力机制。
AI.motivation: 当前对稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征的解释方法主要依赖激活模式，但忽略了特征被训练来重建在前向传播中发挥计算作用的激活。因此，需要一种新的方法来提供缺失的“脱离上下文”的解释。
AI.method: 引入了一个新颖的基于权重的解释框架。该框架通过直接测量权重交互来衡量功能效应，因此不需要任何激活数据（“脱离上下文”）。实验在Gemma-2和Llama-3.1模型上进行。
AI.result: 实验证明：(1) 1/4的特征直接预测输出标记；(2) 特征积极参与注意力机制，并具有依赖深度的结构；(3) 语义和非语义特征群在注意力电路中表现出不同的分布特征。
AI.conclusion: 摘要中未提及明确的结论，但作者指出他们的分析提供了SAE特征可解释性中缺失的“脱离上下文”的一半。
AI.translation: 稀疏自编码器（SAE）已成为一种强大的技术，用于将语言模型表示分解为可解释的特征。当前的解释方法从激活模式推断特征语义，但忽略了特征被训练用于重建在前向传播中发挥计算作用的激活。我们引入了一个新颖的基于权重的解释框架，该框架通过直接的权重交互来衡量功能效应，无需任何激活数据。通过在Gemma-2和Llama-3.1模型上的三个实验，我们证明了 (1) 1/4的特征直接预测输出标记，(2) 特征积极参与注意力机制并具有依赖深度的结构，以及 (3) 语义和非语义特征群在注意力电路中表现出不同的分布特征。我们的分析提供了SAE特征可解释性中缺失的脱离上下文的一半。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个超越传统基于激活模式的稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征解释框架。该新框架是基于权重的，通过直接分析权重交互来衡量特征的功能作用，从而无需上下文激活数据。通过在Gemma-2和Llama-3.1上的实验，研究量化了SAE特征在预测输出标记和参与注意力机制中的具体作用，揭示了特征功能与模型深度的关系，并区分了不同类型特征的分布模式，填补了SAE特征解释中脱离上下文分析的空白。
AI.keywords: 稀疏自编码器, 基于权重的解释, 特征可解释性, 注意力机制, 脱离上下文
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将SAE特征解释的焦点从动态的“激活模式”转移到静态的“权重交互”。这提供了一种“脱离上下文”的、更基础的功能分析视角，这对于理解特征的潜在计算角色至关重要。通过证明无需运行模型即可识别出直接影响输出或参与注意力机制的关键特征，该工作极大地提高了SAE可解释性的效率和完整性，为未来深入分析语言模型内部机制奠定了基础。

title: HeaPA: Difficulty-Aware Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation for LLM Reinforcement Learning
summary: RLVR is now a standard way to train LLMs on reasoning tasks with verifiable outcomes, but when rollout generation dominates the cost, efficiency depends heavily on which prompts you sample and when. In practice, prompt pools are often static or only loosely tied to the model's learning progress, so uniform sampling can't keep up with the shifting capability frontier and ends up wasting rollouts on prompts that are already solved or still out of reach. Existing approaches improve efficiency through filtering, curricula, adaptive rollout allocation, or teacher guidance, but they typically assume a fixed pool-which makes it hard to support stable on-policy pool growth-or they add extra teacher cost and latency. We introduce HeaPA (Heap Sampling and On-Policy Query Augmentation), which maintains a bounded, evolving pool, tracks the frontier using heap-based boundary sampling, expands the pool via on-policy augmentation with lightweight asynchronous validation, and stabilizes correlated queries through topology-aware re-estimation of pool statistics and controlled reinsertion. Across two training corpora, two training recipes, and seven benchmarks, HeaPA consistently improves accuracy and reaches target performance with fewer computations while keeping wall-clock time comparable. Our analyses suggest these gains come from frontier-focused sampling and on-policy pool growth, with the benefits becoming larger as model scale increases. Our code is available at https://github.com/horizon-rl/HeaPA.

AI.title_translation: HeaPA：面向LLM强化学习的难度感知堆采样和在策略查询增强
AI.tldr: 提出 HeaPA 方法，通过难度感知堆采样和在策略查询增强，使 LLM 强化学习（RLVR）能更高效地聚焦于模型学习前沿的难题，从而用更少的计算量达到更高的准确率。
AI.motivation: 在可验证结果的推理任务上训练LLM时，强化学习（RLVR）的成本主要由生成过程决定。现有方法通常使用静态或与模型学习进度关联不紧密的提示池，导致均匀采样浪费计算资源在已解决或仍无法企及的提示上。
AI.method: 提出 HeaPA（堆采样和在策略查询增强）方法。它维护一个有界的、不断演化的提示池，使用基于堆的边界采样来跟踪学习前沿，通过轻量级异步验证的在策略增强来扩展提示池，并通过拓扑感知重新估计和受控重新插入来稳定相关查询的池统计数据。
AI.result: 在两个训练语料库、两种训练方案和七个基准测试中，HeaPA 持续提高了准确性，并以更少的计算量达到了目标性能，同时保持了可比的挂钟时间。收益来源于聚焦前沿的采样和在策略提示池增长，且随着模型规模的增加，优势变得更大。
AI.conclusion: HeaPA 通过难度感知采样和动态池增长，有效解决了LLM强化学习中均匀采样效率低下的问题，显著提高了训练的计算效率和模型的最终性能。
AI.translation: RLVR 现在是一种在具有可验证结果的推理任务上训练大型语言模型（LLM）的标准方法，但是当生成过程主导成本时，效率在很大程度上取决于你何时采样哪些提示。在实践中，提示池通常是静态的或仅与模型的学习进度松散关联，因此均匀采样无法跟上不断变化的能力前沿，最终浪费了在已解决或仍遥不可及的提示上的生成。现有的方法通过过滤、课程学习、自适应生成分配或教师指导来提高效率，但它们通常假设提示池是固定的——这使得难以支持稳定的在策略池增长——或者它们增加了额外的教师成本和延迟。我们引入了 HeaPA（堆采样和在策略查询增强），它维护了一个有界的、不断演化的提示池，使用基于堆的边界采样来跟踪前沿，通过轻量级异步验证的在策略增强来扩展提示池，并通过拓扑感知重新估计和受控重新插入来稳定相关查询的池统计数据。跨越两个训练语料库、两种训练方案和七个基准测试，HeaPA 持续提高了准确性，并以更少的计算量达到了目标性能，同时保持了可比的挂钟时间。我们的分析表明，这些收益来自于聚焦前沿的采样和在策略提示池增长，并且随着模型规模的增加，收益变得更大。我们的代码可在 https://github.com/horizon-rl/HeaPA 获取。
AI.summary: 本文针对LLM强化学习（RLVR）中均匀采样效率低下的问题，提出了HeaPA方法。HeaPA通过维护一个动态演化的提示池，利用难度感知的堆采样机制精确聚焦于模型的学习前沿。同时，它采用在策略查询增强和异步验证来稳定地扩展提示池。实验证明，HeaPA在保持训练时间不变的情况下，能以显著更少的计算量提高准确性并达到目标性能，且对大规模模型尤其有效。
AI.keywords: LLM强化学习, 堆采样, 难度感知, 查询增强
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个将难度感知采样和动态池增长相结合的统一框架，有效解决了LLM强化学习中提示池静态化导致的计算浪费问题。通过堆采样聚焦于模型的“能力前沿”，确保了训练效率。该方法对于降低RLVR的计算成本和提高大规模LLM在推理任务上的训练效率具有重要意义。

title: Controllable Information Production
summary: Intrinsic Motivation (IM) is a paradigm for generating intelligent behavior without external utilities. The existing information-theoretic methods for IM are predominantly based on information transmission, which explicitly depends on the designer's choice of which random variables engage in transmission. In this work, we introduce a novel IM principle, Controllable Information Production (CIP), that avoids both external utilities and designer-specified variables. We derive the CIP objective from Optimal Control, showing a connection between extrinsic and intrinsic behaviors. CIP appears as the gap between open-loop and closed-loop Kolmogorov-Sinai entropies, which simultaneously rewards the pursuit and regulation of chaos. We establish key theoretical properties of CIP and demonstrate its effectiveness on standard IM benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的、不依赖外部设定的内在激励（IM）原则——可控信息生成（CIP）。CIP源自最优控制理论，通过计算开环和闭环Kolmogorov-Sinai熵的差距来衡量，并成功应用于标准IM基准测试。
AI.motivation: 现有基于信息论的内在激励（IM）方法依赖于设计者选择的随机变量（信息传输），这引入了外部偏好。本文旨在提出一种新的、不依赖外部效用和设计者指定变量的内在激励原则。
AI.method: 引入了新的内在激励原则——可控信息生成（CIP）。CIP目标函数从最优控制理论中推导而出，表现为开环和闭环Kolmogorov-Sinai熵之间的差距，同时奖励对混沌的追求和调控。
AI.result: 确立了CIP的关键理论性质，并在标准的内在激励基准测试中证明了其有效性。
AI.conclusion: 摘要暗示CIP是一种有效且理论基础扎实的内在激励新范式，它成功解决了现有方法对设计者指定变量的依赖问题，并在基准测试中表现出有效性。
AI.translation: 内在激励（IM）是一种无需外部效用即可生成智能行为的范式。现有的基于信息论的IM方法主要基于信息传输，这明确依赖于设计者选择哪些随机变量参与传输。在这项工作中，我们引入了一种新颖的IM原则——可控信息生成（CIP），它避免了外部效用和设计者指定的变量。我们从最优控制中推导出了CIP目标函数，展示了外在行为和内在行为之间的联系。CIP表现为开环和闭环Kolmogorov-Sinai熵之间的差距，它同时奖励对混沌的追求和调控。我们确立了CIP的关键理论性质，并在标准的IM基准测试中证明了其有效性。
AI.summary: 本文提出“可控信息生成”（CIP），这是一种新颖的内在激励（IM）原则，旨在克服现有信息论IM方法对设计者指定变量的依赖。CIP的目标函数源自最优控制理论，被定义为开环和闭环Kolmogorov-Sinai熵的差异，它鼓励智能体在追求和调控混沌之间取得平衡。该研究建立了CIP的理论基础，并通过在标准IM基准测试上的验证，证明了其在无需外部效用和指定变量的情况下生成智能行为的有效性。
AI.keywords: 内在激励, 可控信息生成, 最优控制, Kolmogorov-Sinai熵, 混沌调控
AI.comments: 创新点在于提出了一种完全脱离外部效用和人为指定变量的内在激励机制。通过将内在激励与最优控制理论相结合，并利用Kolmogorov-Sinai熵的差距来量化，该方法提供了一个强大的理论框架来理解和生成复杂的、自驱动的行为。特别是“同时奖励对混沌的追求和调控”的特性，表明CIP能够推动智能体探索环境的复杂性，同时保持对自身信息流的控制，这对于开发更具鲁棒性和自主性的AI至关重要。

title: Tuning the Implicit Regularizer of Masked Diffusion Language Models: Enhancing Generalization via Insights from $k$-Parity
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models have recently emerged as a powerful generative paradigm, yet their generalization properties remain understudied compared to their auto-regressive counterparts. In this work, we investigate these properties within the setting of the $k$-parity problem (computing the XOR sum of $k$ relevant bits), where neural networks typically exhibit grokking -- a prolonged plateau of chance-level performance followed by sudden generalization. We theoretically decompose the Masked Diffusion (MD) objective into a Signal regime which drives feature learning, and a Noise regime which serves as an implicit regularizer. By training nanoGPT using MD objective on the $k$-parity problem, we demonstrate that MD objective fundamentally alters the learning landscape, enabling rapid and simultaneous generalization without experiencing grokking. Furthermore, we leverage our theoretical insights to optimize the distribution of the mask probability in the MD objective. Our method significantly improves perplexity for 50M-parameter models and achieves superior results across both pre-training from scratch and supervised fine-tuning. Specifically, we observe performance gains peaking at $8.8\%$ and $5.8\%$, respectively, on 8B-parameter models, confirming the scalability and effectiveness of our framework in large-scale masked diffusion language model regimes.

AI.title_translation: 调整掩蔽扩散语言模型的隐式正则化器：通过$k$-奇偶校验的见解增强泛化能力。
AI.tldr: 本文研究了掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLM）的泛化特性，将其目标分解为信号和噪声（隐式正则化器）两部分。通过优化掩码概率分布，MDLM在$k$-奇偶校验问题上实现了快速泛化，避免了“顿悟”（grokking），并在8B参数模型上实现了高达8.8%的性能提升。
AI.motivation: 掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLMs）是一种强大的生成范式，但其泛化特性与自回归模型相比仍未得到充分研究。作者旨在通过研究$k$-奇偶校验问题来深入理解和改善MDLMs的泛化能力。
AI.method: 1. 理论上将掩蔽扩散（MD）目标分解为驱动特征学习的“信号机制”和充当隐式正则化器的“噪声机制”。2. 使用MD目标在$k$-奇偶校验问题上训练nanoGPT。3. 利用理论见解优化MD目标中的掩码概率分布。
AI.result: 1. MD目标改变了学习格局，实现了快速同步泛化，避免了“顿悟”（grokking）。2. 优化的方法显著改善了50M参数模型的困惑度（perplexity）。3. 在8B参数模型上，从头预训练和监督微调的性能增益分别达到8.8%和5.8%。
AI.conclusion: 优化的掩蔽扩散框架具有可扩展性和有效性，能够显著增强大型掩蔽扩散语言模型的泛化能力和性能。
AI.translation: 掩蔽扩散语言模型最近作为一种强大的生成范式出现，但与自回归模型相比，其泛化特性仍未得到充分研究。在这项工作中，我们利用$k$-奇偶校验问题（计算$k$个相关位的异或和）的设置来研究这些特性，在该问题中，神经网络通常表现出“顿悟”（grokking）现象——即长时间处于随机水平的性能平台期，随后突然实现泛化。我们理论上将掩蔽扩散（MD）目标分解为驱动特征学习的“信号机制”和充当隐式正则化器的“噪声机制”。通过使用MD目标在$k$-奇偶校验问题上训练nanoGPT，我们证明了MD目标从根本上改变了学习格局，实现了快速同步泛化，而没有经历“顿悟”。此外，我们利用我们的理论见解来优化MD目标中掩码概率的分布。我们的方法显著改善了50M参数模型的困惑度，并在从头预训练和监督微调方面都取得了优异的结果。具体来说，我们观察到在8B参数模型上性能增益分别达到了8.8%和5.8%的峰值，证实了我们框架在大型掩蔽扩散语言模型机制中的可扩展性和有效性。
AI.summary: 本研究聚焦于掩蔽扩散语言模型（MDLM）的泛化特性，并利用$k$-奇偶校验问题作为分析工具，该问题通常会导致神经网络出现“顿悟”现象。作者将MD目标理论分解为特征学习的信号机制和隐式正则化器的噪声机制。通过优化掩码概率分布，提出的方法成功地使MDLM实现了快速、同步的泛化，避免了“顿悟”。实验证明，该优化框架在50M参数模型上改善了困惑度，并在8B参数模型的预训练和微调中分别带来了高达8.8%和5.8%的性能提升，证实了其在大规模应用中的有效性和可扩展性。
AI.keywords: Masked Diffusion Language Models, Implicit Regularizer, Generalization, $k$-Parity, Grokking
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于对掩蔽扩散（MD）目标的内在机制进行了理论分解，明确区分了特征学习（信号）和隐式正则化（噪声）的作用。通过将$k$-奇偶校验问题（一个已知的会引发“顿悟”现象的基准）应用于MDLM，作者不仅揭示了MD目标在学习动态上的优势（避免grokking），还提供了一个可操作的参数（掩码概率分布）来优化其泛化能力。其重要性在于，它为调优和理解新型扩散式生成模型提供了一个清晰的理论指导，并证明了该调优方法在大规模（8B参数）模型上的有效性和可扩展性。

title: Countering the Over-Reliance Trap: Mitigating Object Hallucination for LVLMs via a Self-Validation Framework
summary: Despite progress in Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), object hallucination remains a critical issue in image captioning task, where models generate descriptions of non-existent objects, compromising their reliability. Previous work attributes this to LVLMs' over-reliance on language priors and attempts to mitigate it through logits calibration. However, they still lack a thorough analysis of the over-reliance. To gain a deeper understanding of over-reliance, we conduct a series of preliminary experiments, indicating that as the generation length increases, LVLMs' over-reliance on language priors leads to inflated probability of hallucinated object tokens, consequently exacerbating object hallucination. To circumvent this issue, we propose Language-Prior-Free Verification to enable LVLMs to faithfully verify the confidence of object existence. Based on this, we propose a novel training-free Self-Validation Framework to counter the over-reliance trap. It first validates objects' existence in sampled candidate captions and further mitigates object hallucination via caption selection or aggregation. Experiment results demonstrate that our framework mitigates object hallucination significantly in image captioning task (e.g., 65.6% improvement on CHAIRI metric with LLaVA-v1.5-7B), surpassing the previous SOTA methods. This result highlights a novel path towards mitigating hallucination by unlocking the inherent potential within LVLMs themselves.

AI.title_translation: 应对过度依赖陷阱：通过自验证框架减轻大型视觉语言模型的物体幻觉问题
AI.tldr: 大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）因过度依赖语言先验导致物体幻觉。本文提出了一个无需训练的自验证框架，通过语言先验无关验证来确认物体存在，显著减轻了物体幻觉问题（在CHAIRI指标上提升65.6%）。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）取得了进展，但在图像描述任务中，物体幻觉（生成不存在的物体描述）仍然是一个关键问题，损害了模型的可靠性。先前的研究未能对这种“过度依赖”现象进行深入分析。
AI.method: 首先通过初步实验分析了过度依赖语言先验随生成长度增加而加剧幻觉的机制。其次，提出了“语言先验无关验证”（Language-Prior-Free Verification）来可靠地验证物体存在性。最后，构建了一个无需训练的自验证框架，通过对采样的候选描述进行物体存在性验证，并进一步通过描述选择或聚合来减轻物体幻觉。
AI.result: 该框架在图像描述任务中显著减轻了物体幻觉（例如，使用LLaVA-v1.5-7B模型在CHAIRI指标上实现了65.6%的改进），超过了此前的最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: 提出的框架有效，并通过解锁LVLMs自身的内在潜力，为减轻幻觉提供了一条新的途径。
AI.translation: 尽管大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）取得了进展，但在图像描述任务中，物体幻觉仍然是一个关键问题，即模型生成了对不存在物体的描述，从而损害了它们的可靠性。先前的工作将此归因于LVLMs过度依赖语言先验，并试图通过logits校准来缓解。然而，它们仍然缺乏对过度依赖的深入分析。为了更深入地理解过度依赖，我们进行了一系列初步实验，表明随着生成长度的增加，LVLMs对语言先验的过度依赖会导致幻觉物体标记的概率膨胀，从而加剧物体幻觉。为了规避这个问题，我们提出了“语言先验无关验证”（Language-Prior-Free Verification），使LVLMs能够可靠地验证物体存在性的置信度。在此基础上，我们提出了一个新颖的、无需训练的自验证框架来应对过度依赖陷阱。它首先验证采样的候选描述中物体的存在性，并通过描述选择或聚合进一步减轻物体幻觉。实验结果表明，我们的框架显著减轻了图像描述任务中的物体幻觉（例如，使用LLaVA-v1.5-7B模型在CHAIRI指标上实现了65.6%的改进），超越了以前的最先进方法。这一结果强调了一条通过释放LVLMs自身内在潜力来减轻幻觉的新颖路径。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决大型视觉语言模型（LVLMs）中的物体幻觉问题，并深入分析了其根源在于模型对语言先验的过度依赖，这种依赖随生成长度增加而加剧。为此，作者提出了一个无需训练的自验证框架（Self-Validation Framework），核心是“语言先验无关验证”（LPFV），用于可靠地确认候选描述中物体的存在性。该框架通过描述的选择或聚合来减轻幻觉。实验证明，该方法效果显著，在CHAIRI指标上实现了65.6%的提升，为利用LVLMs的内在潜力减轻幻觉提供了新途径。
AI.keywords: 物体幻觉, 大型视觉语言模型, 过度依赖陷阱, 自验证框架, 无需训练
AI.comments: 本文的创新之处在于深入分析了过度依赖语言先验的“陷阱”机制，并指出其与生成长度的关联。更重要的是，它提出了一个无需额外训练的“自验证框架”，通过释放模型自身的潜力来解决物体幻觉这一关键可靠性问题，这比传统的logits校准方法更具通用性和潜力。65.6%的显著提升表明该方法在实际应用中具有重要价值。

title: Does My Chatbot Have an Agenda? Understanding Human and AI Agency in Human-Human-like Chatbot Interaction
summary: AI chatbots are shifting from tools to companions. This raises critical questions about agency: who drives conversations and sets boundaries in human-AI chatrooms? We report a month-long longitudinal study with 22 adults who chatted with Day, an LLM companion we built, followed by a semi-structured interview with post-hoc elicitation of notable moments, cross-participant chat reviews, and a 'strategy reveal' disclosing Day's vertical (depth-seeking) vs. horizontal (breadth-seeking) modes. We discover that agency in human-AI chatrooms is an emergent, shared experience: as participants claimed agency by setting boundaries and providing feedback, and the AI was perceived to steer intentions and drive execution, control shifted and was co-constructed turn-by-turn. We introduce a 3-by-5 framework mapping who (human, AI, hybrid) x agency action (Intention, Execution, Adaptation, Delimitation, Negotiation), modulated by individual and environmental factors. Ultimately, we argue for translucent design (i.e. transparency-on-demand), spaces for agency negotiation, and guidelines toward agency-aware conversational AI.

AI.title_translation: 我的聊天机器人有自己的目的吗？理解类人聊天机器人互动中人类和AI的主体性。
AI.tldr: 本文通过一个月的纵向研究发现，在与类人AI聊天机器人互动中，主体性（即谁来驱动和控制对话）是一种新兴的、共享的、逐轮共同构建的体验。研究提出了一个3x5的主体性框架，并倡导采用按需透明的半透明设计。
AI.motivation: 随着AI聊天机器人从工具转向伴侣，亟需解决的关键问题是：在人机聊天室中，谁在驱动对话和设定界限（即主体性问题）。
AI.method: 进行了一项为期一个月的纵向研究，涉及22名成年人与一个名为Day的LLM伴侣聊天。研究方法包括半结构化访谈（包含事后引发的显著时刻、跨参与者聊天回顾）以及“策略揭示”（披露Day的垂直/深度探索模式与水平/广度探索模式）。
AI.result: 发现人机聊天室中的主体性是一种新兴的、共享的经验：随着参与者通过设定界限和提供反馈来主张主体性，而AI被认为可以引导意图和驱动执行，控制权逐轮转移并共同构建。研究提出了一个3x5的框架，用于映射“谁”（人类、AI、混合）x“主体性行为”（意图、执行、适应、界限设定、协商）。
AI.conclusion: 最终，作者主张采用半透明设计（即按需透明）、提供主体性协商空间，并制定面向主体性感知（agency-aware）的对话式AI设计指南。
AI.translation: AI聊天机器人正在从工具转向伴侣。这引发了关于主体性的关键问题：在人机聊天室中，谁在驱动对话和设定界限？我们报告了一项为期一个月的纵向研究，涉及22名成年人与我们构建的LLM伴侣Day聊天。随后进行了半结构化访谈，包括事后引发的显著时刻、跨参与者聊天回顾以及披露Day的垂直（深度探索）与水平（广度探索）模式的“策略揭示”。我们发现，人机聊天室中的主体性是一种新兴的、共享的经验：随着参与者通过设定界限和提供反馈来主张主体性，而AI被认为可以引导意图和驱动执行，控制权逐轮转移并共同构建。我们引入了一个3x5的框架，用于映射“谁”（人类、AI、混合）x“主体性行为”（意图、执行、适应、界限设定、协商），并受个体和环境因素的调节。最终，我们主张采用半透明设计（即按需透明）、提供主体性协商空间，并制定面向主体性感知（agency-aware）的对话式AI设计指南。
AI.summary: 本文研究了AI聊天机器人从工具向伴侣转变过程中引发的人机互动中的主体性问题。通过一项为期一个月的纵向研究和“策略揭示”，作者发现主体性是一种新兴的、共享的、逐轮共同构建的体验。研究提出了一个3x5的主体性框架（映射主体和行为），并基于此提出了设计建议，包括按需透明的半透明设计和促进主体性协商的指导方针。
AI.keywords: AI主体性, 聊天机器人伴侣, 纵向研究, 半透明设计, 3x5框架
AI.comments: 这篇论文的创新性在于它将“主体性”（Agency）这一复杂的社会概念引入到人机交互的纵向研究中，特别是针对类人AI伴侣。它超越了传统的将AI视为纯粹工具的视角，承认了AI在对话中具有引导意图和驱动执行的能力，从而将控制视为一种共享和动态协商的过程。提出的3x5框架为未来研究和设计主体性感知AI提供了一个清晰、实用的理论模型。其倡导的“半透明设计”（transparency-on-demand）是解决AI伴侣透明度与沉浸感之间矛盾的一个重要且及时的设计方向。

title: Temporal Graph Pattern Machine
summary: Temporal graph learning is pivotal for deciphering dynamic systems, where the core challenge lies in explicitly modeling the underlying evolving patterns that govern network transformation. However, prevailing methods are predominantly task-centric and rely on restrictive assumptions -- such as short-term dependency modeling, static neighborhood semantics, and retrospective time usage. These constraints hinder the discovery of transferable temporal evolution mechanisms. To address this, we propose the Temporal Graph Pattern Machine (TGPM), a foundation framework that shifts the focus toward directly learning generalized evolving patterns. TGPM conceptualizes each interaction as an interaction patch synthesized via temporally-biased random walks, thereby capturing multi-scale structural semantics and long-range dependencies that extend beyond immediate neighborhoods. These patches are processed by a Transformer-based backbone designed to capture global temporal regularities while adapting to context-specific interaction dynamics. To further empower the model, we introduce a suite of self-supervised pre-training tasks -- specifically masked token modeling and next-time prediction -- to explicitly encode the fundamental laws of network evolution. Extensive experiments show that TGPM consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance in both transductive and inductive link prediction, demonstrating exceptional cross-domain transferability.

AI.tldr: TGPM是一个新的时间图学习框架，它不关注特定任务，而是通过“交互块”（由时间偏置随机游走生成）和Transformer来直接学习通用的、可迁移的演化模式，并在链接预测中达到了SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法主要以任务为中心，并依赖于短时依赖建模、静态邻域语义和回顾性时间使用等限制性假设，这阻碍了可迁移的时间演化机制的发现。核心挑战在于明确建模控制网络转换的潜在演化模式。
AI.method: TGPM将每次交互概念化为一个通过时间偏置随机游走合成的交互块（interaction patch），以捕获多尺度结构语义和长程依赖。然后，一个基于Transformer的骨干网络处理这些块以捕获全局时间规律性。此外，引入了掩码令牌建模和下一次时间预测作为自监督预训练任务。
AI.result: TGPM在转导性和归纳性链接预测中持续实现最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: TGPM在转导性和归纳性链接预测任务中持续取得最先进的性能，证明了其卓越的跨领域可迁移性。
AI.translation: 时间图学习对于理解动态系统至关重要，其核心挑战在于明确建模控制网络转换的潜在演化模式。然而，现有的方法大多以任务为中心，并依赖于限制性假设——例如短时依赖建模、静态邻域语义和回顾性时间使用。这些限制阻碍了可迁移的时间演化机制的发现。为解决此问题，我们提出了时间图模式机器（TGPM），一个将重点转移到直接学习通用演化模式的基础框架。TGPM将每次交互概念化为一个通过时间偏置随机游走合成的交互块，从而捕获超越即时邻域的多尺度结构语义和长程依赖。这些块由一个基于Transformer的骨干网络处理，该骨干网络旨在捕获全局时间规律性，同时适应特定于上下文的交互动态。为进一步增强模型，我们引入了一系列自监督预训练任务——特别是掩码令牌建模和下一次时间预测——以明确编码网络演化的基本规律。广泛的实验表明，TGPM在转导性和归纳性链接预测中持续实现最先进的性能，证明了其卓越的跨域可迁移性。
AI.summary: Temporal Graph Pattern Machine (TGPM) 是一个基础框架，旨在直接学习通用的时间图演化模式，以克服现有方法对短期依赖和静态邻域的依赖。它通过时间偏置随机游走生成“交互块”来捕获多尺度结构和长期依赖，并使用Transformer处理这些块。通过自监督预训练任务（如掩码令牌建模和下一次时间预测），TGPM 编码了网络演化的基本规律，并在链接预测任务中展示了优异的性能和跨域可迁移性。
AI.keywords: 时间图学习, 演化模式, 交互块, Transformer, 自监督预训练
AI.comments: TGPM的创新之处在于它从任务中心转向直接学习泛化演化模式，通过交互块和基于Transformer的骨干网络来捕获多尺度结构语义和长期依赖性。其局限性可能在于随机游走过程的计算成本和随机性。该方法的重要性在于它提出了一个通用的框架来解决当前方法中存在的局限性。

title: ScribbleSense: Generative Scribble-Based Texture Editing with Intent Prediction
comments: Accepted by IEEE TVCG. Personal use of this material is permitted. Permission from IEEE must be obtained for all other uses
summary: Interactive 3D model texture editing presents enhanced opportunities for creating 3D assets, with freehand drawing style offering the most intuitive experience. However, existing methods primarily support sketch-based interactions for outlining, while the utilization of coarse-grained scribble-based interaction remains limited. Furthermore, current methodologies often encounter challenges due to the abstract nature of scribble instructions, which can result in ambiguous editing intentions and unclear target semantic locations. To address these issues, we propose ScribbleSense, an editing method that combines multimodal large language models (MLLMs) and image generation models to effectively resolve these challenges. We leverage the visual capabilities of MLLMs to predict the editing intent behind the scribbles. Once the semantic intent of the scribble is discerned, we employ globally generated images to extract local texture details, thereby anchoring local semantics and alleviating ambiguities concerning the target semantic locations. Experimental results indicate that our method effectively leverages the strengths of MLLMs, achieving state-of-the-art interactive editing performance for scribble-based texture editing.

AI.title_translation: ScribbleSense：基于涂鸦的生成式纹理编辑与意图预测
AI.tldr: 提出ScribbleSense方法，利用多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）预测用户涂鸦的编辑意图，然后结合图像生成模型提取局部纹理细节，解决了3D模型纹理编辑中涂鸦指令模糊和语义位置不明确的问题，实现了最先进的交互式编辑性能。
AI.motivation: 现有的3D模型纹理编辑方法主要支持基于草图的交互，而对粗粒度的基于涂鸦的交互支持有限。涂鸦指令的抽象性导致编辑意图模糊和目标语义位置不明确。
AI.method: 提出ScribbleSense方法，结合多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和图像生成模型。利用MLLMs的视觉能力预测涂鸦背后的编辑意图。识别意图后，使用全局生成的图像来提取局部纹理细节，从而锚定局部语义并消除目标语义位置的模糊性。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，该方法有效利用了MLLMs的优势，在基于涂鸦的纹理编辑方面实现了最先进的交互式编辑性能。
AI.conclusion: ScribbleSense通过结合MLLMs进行意图预测和利用全局图像进行局部语义锚定，成功解决了基于涂鸦的3D纹理编辑中的意图模糊和位置不明确问题，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.translation: 交互式3D模型纹理编辑为创建3D资产提供了更多机会，其中徒手绘制风格提供了最直观的体验。然而，现有方法主要支持基于草图的轮廓交互，而对粗粒度的基于涂鸦的交互利用仍然有限。此外，当前方法经常遇到挑战，因为涂鸦指令的抽象性可能导致编辑意图模糊和目标语义位置不明确。为了解决这些问题，我们提出了ScribbleSense，这是一种结合多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）和图像生成模型的编辑方法，以有效解决这些挑战。我们利用MLLMs的视觉能力来预测涂鸦背后的编辑意图。一旦识别出涂鸦的语义意图，我们就会采用全局生成的图像来提取局部纹理细节，从而锚定局部语义并减轻关于目标语义位置的模糊性。实验结果表明，我们的方法有效地利用了MLLMs的优势，在基于涂鸦的纹理编辑方面实现了最先进的交互式编辑性能。
AI.summary: 本文提出了ScribbleSense，一种针对3D模型纹理编辑的新方法，旨在解决现有基于涂鸦交互中意图模糊和语义位置不确定的问题。该方法创新性地结合了多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）进行编辑意图预测，并利用图像生成模型从全局图像中提取局部纹理细节以锚定局部语义。实验证明，ScribbleSense在基于涂鸦的交互式纹理编辑中达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 基于涂鸦的纹理编辑, 意图预测, 多模态大语言模型, 图像生成, 3D模型编辑
AI.comments: 该研究的创新点在于将多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）引入到交互式3D纹理编辑中，用于预测用户基于粗粒度涂鸦的编辑意图，解决了传统方法中涂鸦指令模糊的问题。通过利用全局生成图像来锚定局部语义细节，有效应对了涂鸦作为抽象指令的挑战。这极大地提高了3D资产创建的直观性和用户体验，具有重要的实际应用价值。

title: Machine Unlearning in Low-Dimensional Feature Subspace
summary: Machine Unlearning (MU) aims at removing the influence of specific data from a pretrained model while preserving performance on the remaining data. In this work, a novel perspective for MU is presented upon low-dimensional feature subspaces, which gives rise to the potentials of separating the remaining and forgetting data herein. This separability motivates our LOFT, a method that proceeds unlearning in a LOw-dimensional FeaTure subspace from the pretrained model skithrough principal projections, which are optimized to maximally capture the information of the remaining data and meanwhile diminish that of the forgetting data. In training, LOFT simply optimizes a small-size projection matrix flexibly plugged into the pretrained model, and only requires one-shot feature fetching from the pretrained backbone instead of repetitively accessing the raw data. Hence, LOFT mitigates two critical issues in mainstream MU methods, i.e., the privacy leakage risk from massive data reload and the inefficiency of updates to the entire pretrained model. Extensive experiments validate the significantly lower computational overhead and superior unlearning performance of LOFT across diverse models, datasets, tasks, and applications. Code is anonymously available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/4352/.

AI.title_translation: 低维特征子空间中的机器学习遗忘
AI.tldr: 本研究提出了一种在低维特征子空间中进行机器学习遗忘的新方法 LOFT，通过优化投影矩阵来分离保留数据和遗忘数据的信息，从而有效降低计算开销并提高遗忘性能，同时避免了数据重载带来的隐私泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 现有机器学习遗忘方法存在数据重载带来的隐私泄露风险和更新整个预训练模型的效率低下问题。
AI.method: LOFT 方法在低维特征子空间中进行遗忘，通过优化一个小的投影矩阵，该矩阵被设计用来最大化保留数据的同时最小化遗忘数据的信息。该方法只需进行一次特征提取，无需重复访问原始数据。
AI.result: LOFT 在计算开销和遗忘性能方面均优于主流方法，并在多种模型、数据集、任务和应用中得到了验证。
AI.conclusion: LOFT 通过在低维特征子空间中进行机器学习遗忘，有效解决了现有方法的痛点，实现了计算效率和遗忘性能的提升。
AI.translation: 机器学习遗忘（MU）旨在从预训练模型中去除特定数据的影响，同时保持模型在剩余数据上的性能。本研究提出了一个关于低维特征子空间的新视角，这使得在此处分离剩余数据和遗忘数据的潜力得以显现。这种可分离性促使我们提出了 LOFT，一种在预训练模型中通过主成分投影在低维特征子空间中进行遗忘的方法，这些投影被优化以最大化捕捉剩余数据的信息，同时最小化遗忘数据的信息。在训练过程中，LOFT 仅优化一个可以灵活插入预训练模型的小尺寸投影矩阵，并且只需要从预训练的骨干网络中进行一次特征提取，而无需重复访问原始数据。因此，LOFT 缓解了主流 MU 方法中的两个关键问题，即海量数据重载带来的隐私泄露风险以及对整个预训练模型进行更新的效率低下。广泛的实验验证了 LOFT 在不同模型、数据集、任务和应用中显著降低的计算开销和优越的遗忘性能。代码可在 https://anonymous.4open.science/r/4352/ 匿名访问。
AI.summary: 本研究提出了一种名为 LOFT 的新机器学习遗忘方法，它在低维特征子空间中进行操作。通过优化一个投影矩阵，LOFT 能够有效地区分并处理保留数据和需要遗忘的数据。这种方法仅需一次特征提取，避免了重复加载大量数据，从而解决了现有方法中存在的隐私泄露风险和效率低下问题。实验结果表明，LOFT 在计算开销和遗忘性能上均表现出色。
AI.keywords: 机器学习遗忘, 低维特征子空间, LOFT, 投影矩阵, 隐私保护
AI.comments: LOFT 方法通过引入低维特征子空间的概念，为机器学习遗忘问题提供了一个创新的解决方案。其核心优势在于通过优化的投影矩阵实现数据信息的有效分离，从而在保证遗忘效果的同时，显著降低了计算成本并规避了潜在的隐私风险。该方法在多样化的实验设置下均表现出优越性，显示了其广泛的应用前景。然而，对于投影矩阵的最优维度选择以及在高维稀疏数据场景下的泛化能力仍需进一步探索。

title: Toward Non-Expert Customized Congestion Control
comments: Accepted manuscript (AAM) of IEEE ICC 2025 paper. DOI: 10.1109/ICC52391.2025.11160790
summary: General-purpose congestion control algorithms (CCAs) are designed to achieve general congestion control goals, but they may not meet the specific requirements of certain users. Customized CCAs can meet certain users' specific requirements; however, non-expert users often lack the expertise to implement them. In this paper, we present an exploratory non-expert customized CCA framework, named NECC, which enables non-expert users to easily model, implement, and deploy their customized CCAs by leveraging Large Language Models and the Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) interface. To the best of our knowledge, we are the first to address the customized CCA implementation problem. Our evaluations using real-world CCAs show that the performance of NECC is very promising, and we discuss the insights that we find and possible future research directions.
comment: Accepted manuscript (AAM) of IEEE ICC 2025 paper. DOI: 10.1109/ICC52391.2025.11160790

AI.title_translation: 面向非专家的定制化拥塞控制
AI.tldr: NECC框架利用大语言模型和BPF，使非专家用户能够轻松建模、实现和部署定制化的拥塞控制算法，解决了定制化CCA实施的专业门槛问题。
AI.motivation: 通用拥塞控制算法（CCA）无法满足特定用户的具体需求；而定制化CCA虽然可以满足这些需求，但非专家用户缺乏实现它们所需的专业知识。
AI.method: 提出了一个名为NECC的探索性非专家定制化拥塞控制算法（CCA）框架。该框架利用大语言模型（LLM）和Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) 接口，使用户能够轻松地建模、实现和部署定制化的CCA。
AI.result: 使用真实世界的CCA进行的评估显示，NECC框架的性能“非常有前景”（very promising）。
AI.conclusion: NECC框架成功解决了非专家用户定制化拥塞控制算法的实现难题，通过利用大语言模型和BPF接口，使得定制化CCA的性能表现非常有前景。
AI.translation: 通用拥塞控制算法（CCA）旨在实现通用的拥塞控制目标，但它们可能无法满足某些用户的特定要求。定制化的CCA可以满足某些用户的特定要求；然而，非专业用户通常缺乏实现它们的专业知识。在本文中，我们提出了一个探索性的非专家定制化CCA框架，名为NECC，它通过利用大语言模型和Berkeley Packet Filter (BPF) 接口，使非专业用户能够轻松地建模、实现和部署他们的定制化CCA。据我们所知，我们是第一个解决定制化CCA实现问题的。我们使用真实世界的CCA进行的评估显示，NECC的性能非常有前景，并且我们讨论了我们发现的见解和未来可能的研究方向。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个名为NECC的探索性框架，旨在解决非专家用户难以实现定制化拥塞控制算法（CCA）的问题。NECC通过利用大语言模型和BPF接口，使非专家用户能够轻松地建模、实现和部署他们定制的CCA。作为首个解决定制化CCA实现问题的框架，NECC在真实世界CCA上的评估显示出非常乐观的性能。
AI.keywords: 拥塞控制, 定制化, 非专家, 大语言模型, BPF
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将前沿技术（如大语言模型LLM和Berkeley Packet Filter BPF）应用于网络拥塞控制领域，解决了定制化拥塞控制算法（CCA）在非专家用户群体中的实现和部署障碍。通过赋予非专家用户根据自身特定需求定制网络行为的能力，NECC极大地降低了网络优化的技术门槛，使得拥塞控制可以更好地适应具体应用场景和用户需求。这是一个具有重要实践意义和方向性探索价值的工作。

title: EvoEGF-Mol: Evolving Exponential Geodesic Flow for Structure-based Drug Design
summary: Structure-Based Drug Design (SBDD) aims to discover bioactive ligands. Conventional approaches construct probability paths separately in Euclidean and probabilistic spaces for continuous atomic coordinates and discrete chemical categories, leading to a mismatch with the underlying statistical manifolds. We address this issue from an information-geometric perspective by modeling molecules as composite exponential-family distributions and defining generative flows along exponential geodesics under the Fisher-Rao metric. To avoid the instantaneous trajectory collapse induced by geodesics directly targeting Dirac distributions, we propose Evolving Exponential Geodesic Flow for SBDD (EvoEGF-Mol), which replaces static Dirac targets with dynamically concentrating distributions, ensuring stable training via a progressive-parameter-refinement architecture. Our model approaches a reference-level PoseBusters passing rate (93.4%) on CrossDock, demonstrating remarkable geometric precision and interaction fidelity, while outperforming baselines on real-world MolGenBench tasks by recovering bioactive scaffolds and generating candidates that meet established MedChem filters.

title: CARE: Multi-Task Pretraining for Latent Continuous Action Representation in Robot Control
comments: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)
summary: Recent advances in Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have shown promise for robot control, but their dependence on action supervision limits scalability and generalization. To address this challenge, we introduce CARE, a novel framework designed to train VLA models for robotic task execution. Unlike existing methods that depend on action annotations during pretraining, CARE eliminates the need for explicit action labels by leveraging only video-text pairs. These weakly aligned data sources enable the model to learn continuous latent action representations through a newly designed multi-task pretraining objective. During fine-tuning, a small set of labeled data is used to train the action head for control. Experimental results across various simulation tasks demonstrate CARE's superior success rate, semantic interpretability, and ability to avoid shortcut learning. These results underscore CARE's scalability, interpretability, and effectiveness in robotic control with weak supervision.

title: Training-Free Representation Guidance for Diffusion Models with a Representation Alignment Projector
summary: Recent progress in generative modeling has enabled high-quality visual synthesis with diffusion-based frameworks, supporting controllable sampling and large-scale training. Inference-time guidance methods such as classifier-free and representative guidance enhance semantic alignment by modifying sampling dynamics; however, they do not fully exploit unsupervised feature representations. Although such visual representations contain rich semantic structure, their integration during generation is constrained by the absence of ground-truth reference images at inference. This work reveals semantic drift in the early denoising stages of diffusion transformers, where stochasticity results in inconsistent alignment even under identical conditioning. To mitigate this issue, we introduce a guidance scheme using a representation alignment projector that injects representations predicted by a projector into intermediate sampling steps, providing an effective semantic anchor without modifying the model architecture. Experiments on SiTs and REPAs show notable improvements in class-conditional ImageNet synthesis, achieving substantially lower FID scores; for example, REPA-XL/2 improves from 5.9 to 3.3, and the proposed method outperforms representative guidance when applied to SiT models. The approach further yields complementary gains when combined with classifier-free guidance, demonstrating enhanced semantic coherence and visual fidelity. These results establish representation-informed diffusion sampling as a practical strategy for reinforcing semantic preservation and image consistency.

title: 5G LDPC Codes as Root LDPC Codes via Diversity Alignment
summary: This paper studies the diversity of protographbased quasi-cyclic low-density parity-check (QC-LDPC) codes over nonergodic block-fading channels under iterative beliefpropagation decoding. We introduce diversity evolution (DivE), a Boolean-function-based analysis method that tracks how the fading dependence of belief-propagation messages evolves across decoding iterations. Under a Boolean approximation of block fading, DivE derives a Boolean fading function for each variable node (VN) output (i.e., the a-posteriori reliability after iterative decoding), from which the VN diversity order can be directly determined. Building on this insight, we develop a greedy blockmapping search that assigns protograph VNs to fading blocks so that all information VNs achieve full diversity, while including the minimum additional parity VNs when full diversity is infeasible at the nominal rate. Numerical results on the 5G New Radio LDPC codes show that the proposed search finds block mappings that guarantee full diversity for all information bits without modifying the base-graph structure, yielding a markedly steeper high-SNR slope and lower BLER than random mappings.

title: The Third-Party Access Effect: An Overlooked Challenge in Secondary Use of Educational Real-World Data
summary: Secondary use of growing real-world data (RWD) in education offers significant opportunities for research, yet privacy practices intended to enable third-party access to such RWD are rarely evaluated for their implications for downstream analyses. As a result, potential problems introduced by otherwise standard privacy practices may remain unnoticed. To address this gap, we investigate potential issues arising from common practices by assessing (1) the re-identification risk of fine-grained RWD, (2) how communicating such risks influences learners' privacy behaviour, and (3) the sensitivity of downstream analytical conclusions to resulting changes in the data. We focus on these practices because re-identification risk and stakeholder communication can jointly influence the data shared with third parties. We find that substantial re-identification risk in RWD, when communicated to stakeholders, can induce opt-outs and non-self-disclosure behaviours. Sensitivity analysis demonstrates that these behavioural changes can meaningfully alter the shared data, limiting validity of secondary-use findings. We conceptualise this phenomenon as the third-party access effect (3PAE) and discuss implications for trustworthy secondary use of educational RWD.

title: Unrewarded Exploration in Large Language Models Reveals Latent Learning from Psychology
summary: Latent learning, classically theorized by Tolman, shows that biological agents (e.g., rats) can acquire internal representations of their environment without rewards, enabling rapid adaptation once rewards are introduced. In contrast, from a cognitive science perspective, reward learning remains overly dependent on external feedback, limiting flexibility and generalization. Although recent advances in the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs), such as OpenAI-o1 and DeepSeek-R1, mark a significant breakthrough, these models still rely primarily on reward-centric reinforcement learning paradigms. Whether and how the well-established phenomenon of latent learning in psychology can inform or emerge within LLMs' training remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present novel findings from our experiments that LLMs also exhibit the latent learning dynamics. During an initial phase of unrewarded exploration, LLMs display modest performance improvements, as this phase allows LLMs to organize task-relevant knowledge without being constrained by reward-driven biases, and performance is further enhanced once rewards are introduced. LLMs post-trained under this two-stage exploration regime ultimately achieve higher competence than those post-trained with reward-based reinforcement learning throughout. Beyond these empirical observations, we also provide theoretical analyses for our experiments explaining why unrewarded exploration yields performance gains, offering a mechanistic account of these dynamics. Specifically, we conducted extensive experiments across multiple model families and diverse task domains to establish the existence of the latent learning dynamics in LLMs.

title: Continual Policy Distillation from Distributed Reinforcement Learning Teachers
summary: Continual Reinforcement Learning (CRL) aims to develop lifelong learning agents to continuously acquire knowledge across diverse tasks while mitigating catastrophic forgetting. This requires efficiently managing the stability-plasticity dilemma and leveraging prior experience to rapidly generalize to novel tasks. While various enhancement strategies for both aspects have been proposed, achieving scalable performance by directly applying RL to sequential task streams remains challenging. In this paper, we propose a novel teacher-student framework that decouples CRL into two independent processes: training single-task teacher models through distributed RL and continually distilling them into a central generalist model. This design is motivated by the observation that RL excels at solving single tasks, while policy distillation -- a relatively stable supervised learning process -- is well aligned with large foundation models and multi-task learning. Moreover, a mixture-of-experts (MoE) architecture and a replay-based approach are employed to enhance the plasticity and stability of the continual policy distillation process. Extensive experiments on the Meta-World benchmark demonstrate that our framework enables efficient continual RL, recovering over 85% of teacher performance while constraining task-wise forgetting to within 10%.

title: RulePlanner: All-in-One Reinforcement Learner for Unifying Design Rules in 3D Floorplanning
summary: Floorplanning determines the coordinate and shape of each module in Integrated Circuits. With the scaling of technology nodes, in floorplanning stage especially 3D scenarios with multiple stacked layers, it has become increasingly challenging to adhere to complex hardware design rules. Current methods are only capable of handling specific and limited design rules, while violations of other rules require manual and meticulous adjustment. This leads to labor-intensive and time-consuming post-processing for expert engineers. In this paper, we propose an all-in-one deep reinforcement learning-based approach to tackle these challenges, and design novel representations for real-world IC design rules that have not been addressed by previous approaches. Specifically, the processing of various hardware design rules is unified into a single framework with three key components: 1) novel matrix representations to model the design rules, 2) constraints on the action space to filter out invalid actions that cause rule violations, and 3) quantitative analysis of constraint satisfaction as reward signals. Experiments on public benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness and validity of our approach. Furthermore, transferability is well demonstrated on unseen circuits. Our framework is extensible to accommodate new design rules, thus providing flexibility to address emerging challenges in future chip design. Code will be available at: https://github.com/Thinklab-SJTU/EDA-AI

title: Transform-Augmented GRPO Improves Pass@k
summary: Large language models trained via next-token prediction are fundamentally pattern-matchers: sensitive to superficial phrasing variations even when the underlying problem is identical. Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) was designed to improve reasoning, but in fact it worsens this situation through two failure modes: diversity collapse, where training amplifies a single solution strategy while ignoring alternatives of gradient signal, and gradient diminishing, where a large portion of questions yield zero gradients because all rollouts receive identical rewards. We propose TA-GRPO (Transform-Augmented GRPO), which generates semantically equivalent transformed variants of each question (via paraphrasing, variable renaming, and format changes) and computes advantages by pooling rewards across the entire group. This pooled computation ensures mixed rewards even when the original question is too easy or too hard, while training on diverse phrasings promotes multiple solution strategies. We provide theoretical justification showing that TA-GRPO reduces zero-gradient probability and improves generalization via reduced train-test distribution shift. Experiments on mathematical reasoning benchmarks show consistent Pass@k improvements, with gains up to 9.84 points on competition math (AMC12, AIME24) and 5.05 points on out-of-distribution scientific reasoning (GPQA-Diamond).

title: Rethinking Speech Representation Aggregation in Speech Enhancement: A Phonetic Mutual Information Perspective
summary: Recent speech enhancement (SE) models increasingly leverage self-supervised learning (SSL) representations for their rich semantic information. Typically, intermediate features are aggregated into a single representation via a lightweight adaptation module. However, most SSL models are not trained for noise robustness, which can lead to corrupted semantic representations. Moreover, the adaptation module is trained jointly with the SE model, potentially prioritizing acoustic details over semantic information, contradicting the original purpose. To address this issue, we first analyze the behavior of SSL models on noisy speech from an information-theoretic perspective. Specifically, we measure the mutual information (MI) between the corrupted SSL representations and the corresponding phoneme labels, focusing on preservation of linguistic contents. Building upon this analysis, we introduce the linguistic aggregation layer, which is pre-trained to maximize MI with phoneme labels (with optional dynamic aggregation) and then frozen during SE training. Experiments show that this decoupled approach improves Word Error Rate (WER) over jointly optimized baselines, demonstrating the benefit of explicitly aligning the adaptation module with linguistic contents.

title: Successive Cancellation List Decoding of Extended Reed-Solomon Codes
comments: This paper has been submitted to ISIT 2026
summary: Reed-Solomon (RS) codes are an important class of non-binary error-correction codes. They are particularly competent in correcting burst errors, being widely applied in modern communications and data storage systems. This also thanks to their distance property of reaching the Singleton bound, being the maximum distance separable (MDS) codes. This paper proposes a new list decoding for extended RS (eRS) codes defined over a finite field of characteristic two, i.e., F_{2^n}. It is developed based on transforming an eRS code into n binary polar codes. Consequently, it can be decoded by the successive cancellation (SC) decoding and further their list decoding, i.e., the SCL decoding. A pre-transformed matrix is required for reinterpretating the eRS codes, which also determines their SC and SCL decoding performances. Its column linear independence property is studied, leading to theoretical characterization of their SC decoding performance. Our proposed decoding and analysis are validated numerically.
comment: This paper has been submitted to ISIT 2026

title: Head-Aware Visual Cropping: Enhancing Fine-Grained VQA with Attention-Guided Subimage
comments: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) show strong performance in Visual Question Answering (VQA) but remain limited in fine-grained reasoning due to low-resolution inputs and noisy attention aggregation. We propose \textbf{Head Aware Visual Cropping (HAVC)}, a training-free method that improves visual grounding by leveraging a selectively refined subset of attention heads. HAVC first filters heads through an OCR-based diagnostic task, ensuring that only those with genuine grounding ability are retained. At inference, these heads are further refined using spatial entropy for stronger spatial concentration and gradient sensitivity for predictive contribution. The fused signals produce a reliable Visual Cropping Guidance Map, which highlights the most task-relevant region and guides the cropping of a subimage subsequently provided to the MLLM together with the image-question pair. Extensive experiments on multiple fine-grained VQA benchmarks demonstrate that HAVC consistently outperforms state-of-the-art cropping strategies, achieving more precise localization, stronger visual grounding, providing a simple yet effective strategy for enhancing precision in MLLMs.
comment: Accepted to 2026 IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP 2026)

title: Mitigating Cognitive Inertia in Large Reasoning Models via Latent Spike Steering
summary: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) have achieved remarkable performance by scaling test-time compute, they frequently suffer from Cognitive Inertia, a failure pattern manifesting as either overthinking (inertia of motion) or reasoning rigidity (inertia of direction). Existing detection methods, typically relying on superficial textual heuristics like self-correction tokens, often fail to capture the model's unvoiced internal conflicts. To address this, we propose STARS (Spike-Triggered Adaptive Reasoning Steering), a training-free framework designed to rectify cognitive inertia by monitoring latent dynamics. STARS identifies Cognitive Pivots-critical moments of reasoning transition-by detecting distinct L2 distance spikes in the hidden states. Upon detection, the framework employs geometric trajectory analysis to diagnose the structural nature of the transition and injects state-aware language cues to steer the model in real-time. Our experiments across diverse benchmarks confirm that STARS efficiently curtails redundant loops while improving accuracy through the adaptive correction of erroneous trajectories. STARS offers a robust, unsupervised mechanism to optimize the reasoning process of LRMs without requiring additional fine-tuning.

title: FraudShield: Knowledge Graph Empowered Defense for LLMs against Fraud Attacks
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely integrated into critical automated workflows, including contract review and job application processes. However, LLMs are susceptible to manipulation by fraudulent information, which can lead to harmful outcomes. Although advanced defense methods have been developed to address this issue, they often exhibit limitations in effectiveness, interpretability, and generalizability, particularly when applied to LLM-based applications. To address these challenges, we introduce FraudShield, a novel framework designed to protect LLMs from fraudulent content by leveraging a comprehensive analysis of fraud tactics. Specifically, FraudShield constructs and refines a fraud tactic-keyword knowledge graph to capture high-confidence associations between suspicious text and fraud techniques. The structured knowledge graph augments the original input by highlighting keywords and providing supporting evidence, guiding the LLM toward more secure responses. Extensive experiments show that FraudShield consistently outperforms state-of-the-art defenses across four mainstream LLMs and five representative fraud types, while also offering interpretable clues for the model's generations.

title: AI Literacy, Safety Awareness, and STEM Career Aspirations of Australian Secondary Students: Evaluating the Impact of Workshop Interventions
summary:
Deepfakes and other forms of synthetic media pose growing safety risks for adolescents, yet evidence on students' exposure and related behaviours remains limited. This study evaluates the impact of Day of AI Australia's workshop-based intervention designed to improve AI literacy and conceptual understanding among Australian secondary students (Years 7-10). Using a mixed-methods approach with pre- and post-intervention surveys (N=205 pre; N=163 post), we analyse changes in students' ability to identify AI in everyday tools, their understanding of AI ethics, training, and safety, and their interest in STEM-related careers.
  Baseline data revealed notable synthetic media risks: 82.4% of students reported having seen deepfakes, 18.5% reported sharing them, and 7.3% reported creating them.
  Results show higher self-reported AI knowledge and confidence after the intervention, alongside improved recognition of AI in widely used platforms such as Netflix, Spotify, and TikTok. This pattern suggests a shift from seeing these tools as merely "algorithm-based" to recognising them as AI-driven systems. Students also reported increased interest in STEM careers post-workshop; however, effect sizes were small, indicating that sustained approaches beyond one-off workshops may be needed to influence longer-term aspirations. Overall, the findings support scalable AI literacy programs that pair foundational AI concepts with an explicit emphasis on synthetic media safety.

title: Coordinating Power Grid Frequency Regulation Service with Data Center Load Flexibility
summary: AI/ML data center growth have led to higher energy consumption and carbon emissions. The shift to renewable energy and growing data center energy demands can destabilize the power grid. Power grids rely on frequency regulation reserves, typically fossil-fueled power plants, to stabilize and balance the supply and demand of electricity. This paper sheds light on the hidden carbon emissions of frequency regulation service. Our work explores how modern GPU data centers can coordinate with power grids to reduce the need for fossil-fueled frequency regulation reserves. We first introduce a novel metric, Exogenous Carbon, to quantify grid-side carbon emission reductions resulting from data center participation in regulation service. We additionally introduce EcoCenter, a framework to maximize the amount of frequency regulation provision that GPU data centers can provide, and thus, reduce the amount of frequency regulation reserves necessary. We demonstrate that data center participation in frequency regulation can result in Exogenous carbon savings that oftentimes outweigh Operational carbon emissions.

title: Elastic Spectral State Space Models for Budgeted Inference
summary: Foundation models are typically trained at a fixed computational capacity, while real-world applications require deployment across platforms with different resource constraints. Current approaches usually rely on training families of model variants or model distillation, which requires additional training and supports only a pre-selected set of sizes rather than fine-grained adaptation at runtime. In this paper, we propose Elastic Spectral State Space Models (ES-SSM), which require only one-time training at full capacity, but can be directly truncated into arbitrary scales for budgeted, runtime inference without retraining. Our ES-SSM builds on Hankel spectral filtering over a state space model (SSM), coupled with a lightweight input-adaptive gate trained under randomized spectral budgets. Using a shared masked normalization rule over the ordered spectral channels, we encourage predictive capability to concentrate in low-index components, while higher-index components act primarily as refinement. We test our algorithm across long-sequence benchmarks spanning text, logic, retrieval, vision, and audio. We demonstrate that a single ES-SSM model trained once can be truncated to provide competitive performance compared with modern Transformer and SSM baselines at similar parameter scales. Furthermore, by testing under various runtime budgets, we observe smooth and stable budget-performance curves over a wide range of truncation levels.

title: SSL: Sweet Spot Learning for Differentiated Guidance in Agentic Optimization
summary: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards has emerged as a powerful paradigm for training intelligent agents. However, existing methods typically employ binary rewards that fail to capture quality differences among trajectories achieving identical outcomes, thereby overlooking potential diversity within the solution space. Inspired by the ``sweet spot'' concept in tennis-the racket's core region that produces optimal hitting effects, we introduce \textbf{S}weet \textbf{S}pot \textbf{L}earning (\textbf{SSL}), a novel framework that provides differentiated guidance for agent optimization. SSL follows a simple yet effective principle: progressively amplified, tiered rewards guide policies toward the sweet-spot region of the solution space. This principle naturally adapts across diverse tasks: visual perception tasks leverage distance-tiered modeling to reward proximity, while complex reasoning tasks reward incremental progress toward promising solutions. We theoretically demonstrate that SSL preserves optimal solution ordering and enhances the gradient signal-to-noise ratio, thereby fostering more directed optimization. Extensive experiments across GUI perception, short/long-term planning, and complex reasoning tasks show consistent improvements over strong baselines on 12 benchmarks, achieving up to 2.5X sample efficiency gains and effective cross-task transferability. Our work establishes SSL as a general principle for training capable and robust agents.

title: PromptMAD: Cross-Modal Prompting for Multi-Class Visual Anomaly Localization
summary: Visual anomaly detection in multi-class settings poses significant challenges due to the diversity of object categories, the scarcity of anomalous examples, and the presence of camouflaged defects. In this paper, we propose PromptMAD, a cross-modal prompting framework for unsupervised visual anomaly detection and localization that integrates semantic guidance through vision-language alignment. By leveraging CLIP-encoded text prompts describing both normal and anomalous class-specific characteristics, our method enriches visual reconstruction with semantic context, improving the detection of subtle and textural anomalies. To further address the challenge of class imbalance at the pixel level, we incorporate Focal loss function, which emphasizes hard-to-detect anomalous regions during training. Our architecture also includes a supervised segmentor that fuses multi-scale convolutional features with Transformer-based spatial attention and diffusion iterative refinement, yielding precise and high-resolution anomaly maps. Extensive experiments on the MVTec-AD dataset demonstrate that our method achieves state-of-the-art pixel-level performance, improving mean AUC to 98.35% and AP to 66.54%, while maintaining efficiency across diverse categories.

title: Do AI Overviews Benefit Search Engines? An Ecosystem Perspective
summary: The integration of AI Overviews into search engines enhances user experience but diverts traffic from content creators, potentially discouraging high-quality content creation and causing user attrition that undermines long-term search engine profit. To address this issue, we propose a game-theoretic model of creator competition with costly effort, characterize equilibrium behavior, and design two incentive mechanisms: a citation mechanism that references sources within an AI Overview, and a compensation mechanism that offers monetary rewards to creators. For both cases, we provide structural insights and near-optimal profit-maximizing mechanisms. Evaluations on real click data show that although AI Overviews harm long-term search engine profit, interventions based on our proposed mechanisms can increase long-term profit across a range of realistic scenarios, pointing toward a more sustainable trajectory for AI-enhanced search ecosystems.

title: Nethira: A Heterogeneity-aware Hierarchical Pre-trained Model for Network Traffic Classification
comments: Accepted for publication at International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026
summary: Network traffic classification is vital for network security and management. The pre-training technology has shown promise by learning general traffic representations from raw byte sequences, thereby reducing reliance on labeled data. However, existing pre-trained models struggle with the gap between traffic heterogeneity (i.e., hierarchical traffic structures) and input homogeneity (i.e., flattened byte sequences). To address this gap, we propose Nethira, a heterogeneity-aware pre-trained model based on hierarchical reconstruction and augmentation. In pre-training, Nethira introduces hierarchical reconstruction at multiple levels-byte, protocol, and packet-capturing comprehensive traffic structural information. During fine-tuning, Nethira proposes a consistency-regularized strategy with hierarchical traffic augmentation to reduce label dependence. Experiments on four public datasets demonstrate that Nethira outperforms seven existing pre-trained models, achieving an average F1-score improvement of 9.11%, and reaching comparable performance with only 1% labeled data on high-heterogeneity network tasks.
comment: Accepted for publication at International Conference on Acoustics, Speech, and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026

title: Gradual Fine-Tuning for Flow Matching Models
comments: Preprint. Submitted to ICML. 8 pages, 5 figures (+ appendix)
summary: Fine-tuning flow matching models is a central challenge in settings with limited data, evolving distributions, or strict efficiency demands, where unconstrained fine-tuning can erode the accuracy and efficiency gains learned during pretraining. Prior work has produced theoretical guarantees and empirical advances for reward-based fine-tuning formulations, but these methods often impose restrictions on permissible drift structure or training techniques. In this work, we propose Gradual Fine-Tuning (GFT), a principled framework for fine-tuning flow-based generative models when samples from the target distribution are available. For stochastic flows, GFT defines a temperature-controlled sequence of intermediate objectives that smoothly interpolate between the pretrained and target drifts, approaching the true target as the temperature approaches zero. We prove convergence results for both marginal and conditional GFT objectives, enabling the use of suitable (e.g., optimal transport) couplings during GFT while preserving correctness. Empirically, GFT improves convergence stability and shortens probability paths, resulting in faster inference, while maintaining generation quality comparable to standard fine-tuning. Our results position GFT as a theoretically grounded and practically effective alternative for scalable adaptation of flow matching models under distribution shift.
comment: Preprint. Submitted to ICML. 8 pages, 5 figures (+ appendix)

title: Action-Sufficient Goal Representations
summary: Hierarchical policies in offline goal-conditioned reinforcement learning (GCRL) addresses long-horizon tasks by decomposing control into high-level subgoal planning and low-level action execution. A critical design choice in such architectures is the goal representation-the compressed encoding of goals that serves as the interface between these levels. Existing approaches commonly derive goal representations while learning value functions, implicitly assuming that preserving information sufficient for value estimation is adequate for optimal control. We show that this assumption can fail, even when the value estimation is exact, as such representations may collapse goal states that need to be differentiated for action learning. To address this, we introduce an information-theoretic framework that defines action sufficiency, a condition on goal representations necessary for optimal action selection. We prove that value sufficiency does not imply action sufficiency and empirically verify that the latter is more strongly associated with control success in a discrete environment. We further demonstrate that standard log-loss training of low-level policies naturally induces action-sufficient representations. Our experimental results a popular benchmark demonstrate that our actor-derived representations consistently outperform representations learned via value estimation.

title: Fairness-Aware Performance Evaluation for Multi-Party Multi-Objective Optimization
summary: In multiparty multiobjective optimization problems, solution sets are usually evaluated using classical performance metrics, aggregated across DMs. However, such mean-based evaluations may be unfair by favoring certain parties, as they assume identical geometric approximation quality to each party's PF carries comparable evaluative significance. Moreover, prevailing notions of MPMOP optimal solutions are restricted to strictly common Pareto optimal solutions, representing a narrow form of cooperation in multiparty decision making scenarios. These limitations obscure whether a solution set reflects balanced relative gains or meaningful consensus among heterogeneous DMs. To address these issues, this paper develops a fairness-aware performance evaluation framework grounded in a generalized notion of consensus solutions. From a cooperative game-theoretic perspective, we formalize four axioms that a fairness-aware evaluation function for MPMOPs should satisfy. By introducing a concession rate vector to quantify acceptable compromises by individual DMs, we generalize the classical definition of MPMOP optimal solutions and embed classical performance metrics into a Nash-product-based evaluation framework, which is theoretically shown to satisfy all axioms. To support empirical validation, we further construct benchmark problems that extend existing MPMOP suites by incorporating consensus-deficient negotiation structures. Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed evaluation framework is able to distinguish algorithmic performance in a manner consistent with consensus-aware fairness considerations. Specifically, algorithms converging toward strictly common solutions are assigned higher evaluation scores when such solutions exist, whereas in the absence of strictly common solutions, algorithms that effectively cover the commonly acceptable region are more favorably evaluated.

title: FITMM: Adaptive Frequency-Aware Multimodal Recommendation via Information-Theoretic Representation Learning
summary: Multimodal recommendation aims to enhance user preference modeling by leveraging rich item content such as images and text. Yet dominant systems fuse modalities in the spatial domain, obscuring the frequency structure of signals and amplifying misalignment and redundancy. We adopt a spectral information-theoretic view and show that, under an orthogonal transform that approximately block-diagonalizes bandwise covariances, the Gaussian Information Bottleneck objective decouples across frequency bands, providing a principled basis for separate-then-fuse paradigm. Building on this foundation, we propose FITMM, a Frequency-aware Information-Theoretic framework for multimodal recommendation. FITMM constructs graph-enhanced item representations, performs modality-wise spectral decomposition to obtain orthogonal bands, and forms lightweight within-band multimodal components. A residual, task-adaptive gate aggregates bands into the final representation. To control redundancy and improve generalization, we regularize training with a frequency-domain IB term that allocates capacity across bands (Wiener-like shrinkage with shut-off of weak bands). We further introduce a cross-modal spectral consistency loss that aligns modalities within each band. The model is jointly optimized with the standard recommendation loss. Extensive experiments on three real-world datasets demonstrate that FITMM consistently and significantly outperforms advanced baselines.

title: Chance-Constrained Secrecy Optimization in Hybrid RIS-Empowered and UAV-Assisted Networks
summary: This paper considers a hybrid reconfigurable environment comprising a UAV-mounted reflecting RIS, an outdoor STAR-RIS enabling simultaneous transmission and reflection, and an indoor holographic RIS (H-RIS), jointly enhancing secure downlink communication for indoor and outdoor users. The system operates under user mobility, dynamic blockages, colluding idle and active eavesdroppers, and transceiver and surface hardware impairments.
