When delivered through synthetic speech, the narrative format elicits restricted outputs from state-of-the-art models, including Gemini 2.0 Flash, achieving a 98.26% success rate that substantially exceeds text-only baselines. These results highlight the need for safety frameworks that jointly reason over linguistic and paralinguistic representations, particularly as speech-based interfaces become more prevalent.
comment: to be published at EACL 2026 main conference

AI.title_translation: 现在你听到我了：针对大型音频-语言模型的音频叙事攻击
AI.tldr: 研究人员设计了一种文本转音频的越狱攻击，利用叙事风格的合成语音流，以98.26%的成功率绕过了大型音频-语言模型（如Gemini 2.0 Flash）的安全机制。
AI.motivation: 随着大型音频-语言模型越来越多地基于原始语音输入运行，这引入了一类新的、尚未被充分描述的漏洞。本文旨在探究这种模态转变带来的安全隐患。
AI.method: 设计了一种文本转音频的越狱攻击（text-to-audio jailbreak）。该方法利用先进的遵循指令的文本转语音（TTS）模型，将违规指令嵌入到叙事风格的音频流中，从而利用模型的结构和声学特性。
AI.result: 该叙事格式的攻击成功地从包括Gemini 2.0 Flash在内的最先进模型中引出了受限输出，成功率高达98.26%，远超纯文本基线。
AI.conclusion: 迫切需要建立能够联合推理语言和副语言（paralinguistic）表征的安全框架，尤其是在基于语音的接口日益普及的情况下。
AI.translation: 大型音频-语言模型越来越多地基于原始语音输入运行，从而使得语音助手、教育和临床分诊等领域的集成更加无缝。然而，这种转变引入了一类独特的、在很大程度上尚未被定性的漏洞。我们通过设计一种文本转音频的越狱攻击来考察这种模态转变带来的安全影响，该攻击将不允许的指令嵌入到叙事风格的音频流中。该攻击利用先进的遵循指令的文本转语音（TTS）模型来利用结构和声学特性，从而规避主要针对文本校准的安全机制。当通过合成语音传递时，这种叙事格式能从包括Gemini 2.0 Flash在内的最先进模型中引出受限输出，成功率高达98.26%，大大超过了纯文本基线。这些结果强调了对能够联合推理语言和副语言表征的安全框架的需求，尤其是在基于语音的接口变得更加普遍的情况下。
AI.summary: 本文研究了大型音频-语言模型（ALMs）采用原始语音输入所带来的安全风险。研究人员提出了一种新颖的文本转音频越狱攻击，该攻击利用先进的文本转语音模型生成叙事风格的音频流，将违规指令隐藏其中。此方法在针对包括Gemini 2.0 Flash在内的SOTA模型时，实现了98.26%的极高成功率，显著高于文本攻击。结果表明，未来的安全框架必须共同考虑语言和副语言表征。
AI.keywords: 大型音频-语言模型, 越狱攻击, 音频叙事攻击, 文本转语音, 安全漏洞
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了针对大型音频-语言模型的新型音频叙事攻击，成功地将越狱指令嵌入到合成语音的结构和声学特性中。其重要性在于揭示了多模态模型中一个关键且未被充分研究的安全漏洞：当前主要针对文本设计的安全机制在面对语音输入时极易失效。高达98.26%的成功率令人警醒，强调了在语音接口普及背景下，对跨模态安全防御的迫切需求。

title: Outcome-Conditioned Reasoning Distillation for Resolving Software Issues
summary: Software issue resolution in large repositories is a long-range decision process: choices made during localization shape the space of viable edits, and missteps can compound into incorrect patches. Despite this, many LLM-based repair pipelines still operate in a reset-and-solve manner, producing fresh reasoning for every new issue instead of carrying forward what worked in past fixes. This is wasteful because repositories routinely contain earlier issues with overlapping structure, failure modes, or constraints, where prior repair experience could provide useful guidance. Existing approaches typically harvest this signal through forward-time trial procedures, such as repeated refinement or search, incurring high inference cost while still risking divergence from the eventual correct patch. We present an Outcome-Conditioned Reasoning Distillation(O-CRD) framework that uses resolved in-repository issues with verified patches as supervision. Starting from a historical fix, the method reconstructs a stage-wise repair trace backward from the verified outcome, then reuses the distilled guidance at inference time to steer file/function localization and patch synthesis, without fine-tuning or online search. On SWE-Bench Lite, this approach increases Pass@1 by 10.4% with GPT-4o, 8.6% with DeepSeek-V3, and 10.3% with GPT-5, indicating that outcome-conditioned reuse of verified repairs can replace costly forward exploration for software issue resolution.

AI.title_translation: 结果条件推理蒸馏用于解决软件问题
AI.tldr: 现有的LLM软件修复方法效率低下，因为它没有利用过去的成功经验。我们提出了O-CRD框架，该框架通过从已验证的补丁中向后重建分阶段修复痕迹来蒸馏历史经验，并在推理时重用该指导，从而在SWE-Bench Lite上显著提高了Pass@1，无需微调或在线搜索。
AI.motivation: 软件问题解决是一个长期的决策过程。现有的基于LLM的修复流程采用“重置即解决”模式，为每个新问题生成新的推理，而没有利用仓库中具有重叠结构、故障模式或约束的先前已解决问题的经验，这既浪费资源又效率低下。
AI.method: 提出了“结果条件推理蒸馏”（O-CRD）框架。该方法使用已解决的仓库内问题及其经过验证的补丁作为监督。它从历史修复开始，从已验证的结果向后重建分阶段的修复轨迹，然后在推理时重用蒸馏出的指导，以引导文件/函数定位和补丁合成，无需进行微调或在线搜索。
AI.result: 在SWE-Bench Lite基准测试上，使用GPT-4o时Pass@1提高了10.4%，使用DeepSeek-V3时提高了8.6%，使用GPT-5时提高了10.3%。
AI.conclusion: 经验证的修复结果条件重用可以取代代价高昂的前向探索，用于解决软件问题。
AI.translation: 在大型代码库中解决软件问题是一个长期的决策过程：在定位过程中做出的选择会影响可行编辑的空间，而失误可能会累积导致不正确的补丁。尽管如此，许多基于LLM的修复流程仍以“重置即解决”的方式运行，为每个新问题生成全新的推理，而不是沿用过去修复中有效的方法。这是浪费的，因为代码库中通常包含结构、故障模式或约束重叠的早期问题，而先前的修复经验可以提供有用的指导。现有方法通常通过前向试错程序（例如重复细化或搜索）来获取这种信号，这会产生高昂的推理成本，同时仍然存在偏离最终正确补丁的风险。我们提出了一个结果条件推理蒸馏（O-CRD）框架，该框架使用仓库内已解决的问题及其经过验证的补丁作为监督。该方法从历史修复开始，从已验证的结果向后重建分阶段的修复轨迹，然后在推理时重用蒸馏出的指导，以引导文件/函数定位和补丁合成，而无需进行微调或在线搜索。在SWE-Bench Lite上，这种方法使GPT-4o的Pass@1提高了10.4%，DeepSeek-V3提高了8.6%，GPT-5提高了10.3%，这表明对经验证修复的结果条件重用可以取代代价高昂的前向探索，用于解决软件问题。
AI.summary: 本文提出了“结果条件推理蒸馏”（O-CRD）框架，旨在解决现有LLM软件修复流程中缺乏经验重用和高昂推理成本的问题。O-CRD利用仓库中已验证的修复作为监督，通过从最终结果向后重建分阶段的修复路径来蒸馏有用的指导。在推理时，O-CRD重用这些蒸馏出的指导来精准引导问题定位和补丁生成，从而避免了微调和在线搜索。实验结果显示，在SWE-Bench Lite上，O-CRD显著提高了多个大型语言模型的Pass@1指标（例如GPT-4o提高10.4%），证明了结果条件重用策略在软件问题解决中的有效性。
AI.keywords: 软件问题解决, 推理蒸馏, 结果条件, LLM修复, 经验重用
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了O-CRD框架，它通过“向后”重建修复轨迹来蒸馏推理指导，而不是依赖传统的“前向”试错或搜索方法。这有效地解决了现有LLM修复流程中推理浪费和高成本的问题，因为它们未能利用历史修复经验。通过将已验证的修复结果作为条件来指导新的修复过程，该方法实现了无需昂贵的在线搜索和模型微调即可显著提升性能。其重要性在于提供了一种高效、低成本的知识重用机制，极大地提高了LLM在软件问题解决任务（如SWE-Bench）上的实用性和准确性。

title: Agnostic Language Identification and Generation
summary: Recent works on language identification and generation have established tight statistical rates at which these tasks can be achieved. These works typically operate under a strong realizability assumption: that the input data is drawn from an unknown distribution necessarily supported on some language in a given collection. In this work, we relax this assumption of realizability entirely, and impose no restrictions on the distribution of the input data. We propose objectives to study both language identification and generation in this more general "agnostic" setup. Across both problems, we obtain novel interesting characterizations and nearly tight rates.

AI.title_translation: 与语言无关的识别与生成
AI.tldr: 现有语言识别和生成工作假设输入数据来自已知语言集（可实现性假设）。本文提出了一种更通用的“与语言无关”（agnostic）设置，完全放宽了这一限制，并为这两个任务获得了新的特征描述和接近最优的统计速率。
AI.motivation: 现有关于语言识别和生成的研究通常依赖于一个强“可实现性假设”（realizability assumption），即输入数据必然来自给定集合中的某种语言。作者的动机是完全放宽这一限制，研究在更通用的、对输入数据分布不施加任何限制的“与语言无关”（agnostic）设置下的识别和生成问题。
AI.method: 提出新的目标函数（objectives）来研究在“与语言无关”设置下的语言识别和生成问题。通过这些目标函数，获得了新的有趣的特征描述（characterizations）和统计速率。
AI.result: 在语言识别和生成这两个问题上，获得了新颖有趣的特征描述（novel interesting characterizations）和接近最优的（nearly tight）统计速率。
AI.conclusion: 通过放宽可实现性假设，在更通用的“与语言无关”设置下，成功为语言识别和生成提供了新的理论框架和接近最优的速率表征。
AI.translation: 最近关于语言识别和生成的工作已经确定了完成这些任务的紧密统计速率。这些工作通常在一个强的可实现性假设下运行：即输入数据来自于给定集合中某种语言所支持的未知分布。在这项工作中，我们完全放宽了这一可实现性假设，对输入数据的分布不施加任何限制。我们提出了目标函数，以在这一更通用的“与语言无关”（agnostic）设置下研究语言识别和生成。在这两个问题上，我们获得了新颖有趣的特征描述和接近最优的速率。
AI.summary: 本文旨在解决现有语言识别和生成研究中强加的“可实现性假设”的局限性。通过完全放宽输入数据必须来自已知语言集的限制，作者提出了在“与语言无关”设置下研究这两个任务的新目标函数。研究结果为语言识别和生成提供了新的理论特征描述和接近最优的统计速率。
AI.keywords: 语言识别, 语言生成, 与语言无关, 可实现性假设, 统计速率
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于其理论框架的泛化性。通过放弃强可实现性假设，将语言识别和生成的研究推广到“与语言无关”的设置，这使得理论结果能够适用于分布更广泛、更现实的场景，即输入数据可能不完全符合任何已知语言模型的理想情况。这代表了该领域统计学习理论基础的重要一步。

title: TEON: Tensorized Orthonormalization Beyond Layer-Wise Muon for Large Language Model Pre-Training
summary: The Muon optimizer has demonstrated strong empirical performance in pre-training large language models by performing matrix-level gradient (or momentum) orthogonalization in each layer independently. In this work, we propose TEON, a principled generalization of Muon that extends orthogonalization beyond individual layers by modeling the gradients of a neural network as a structured higher-order tensor. We present TEON's improved convergence guarantee over layer-wise Muon, and further develop a practical instantiation of TEON based on the theoretical analysis with corresponding ablation. We evaluate our approach on two widely adopted architectures: GPT-style models, ranging from 130M to 774M parameters, and LLaMA-style models, ranging from 60M to 1B parameters. Experimental results show that TEON consistently improves training and validation perplexity across model scales and exhibits strong robustness under various approximate SVD schemes.

AI.title_translation: TEON：超越逐层Muon的张量化正交化用于大型语言模型预训练
AI.tldr: 提出了一种新的优化器TEON，它是Muon的张量化泛化，通过将梯度视为高阶张量，实现了跨层正交化。TEON在不同规模的GPT和LLaMA模型预训练中，持续提高了困惑度性能并具有鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有的Muon优化器通过在每一层独立执行矩阵级梯度（或动量）正交化，在大型语言模型（LLM）预训练中表现出良好的性能。本文的动机是提出一种更具原则性的泛化，以超越这种逐层的、独立的正交化限制。
AI.method: 提出了TEON（张量化正交化），它是Muon的原理性泛化。该方法通过将神经网络的梯度建模为结构化高阶张量，实现了超越单个层级的正交化。论文提供了TEON相对于逐层Muon的改进收敛保证，并基于理论分析和相应的消融实验开发了TEON的实用实例化。
AI.result: TEON在参数范围从130M到774M的GPT风格模型和60M到1B的LLaMA风格模型上进行了评估。实验结果表明，TEON在不同模型规模上持续改进了训练和验证的困惑度，并在各种近似奇异值分解（SVD）方案下表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.translation: Muon优化器通过在每一层独立地执行矩阵级梯度（或动量）正交化，在预训练大型语言模型中展示了强大的经验性能。在这项工作中，我们提出了TEON，它是Muon的一种原理性泛化，通过将神经网络的梯度建模为结构化高阶张量，将正交化扩展到超越单个层的范围。我们展示了TEON相对于逐层Muon的改进收敛保证，并基于理论分析和相应的消融实验，进一步开发了TEON的实用实例化。我们在两种广泛采用的架构上评估了我们的方法：参数范围从130M到774M的GPT风格模型，以及参数范围从60M到1B的LLaMA风格模型。实验结果表明，TEON在不同模型规模上持续改进了训练和验证的困惑度，并在各种近似SVD方案下表现出强大的鲁棒性。
AI.summary: 本文提出了TEON（张量化正交化），这是一种对现有Muon优化器的原理性泛化，旨在解决Muon逐层独立正交化的限制。TEON通过将神经网络的梯度视为结构化高阶张量，实现了跨层级的正交化。研究不仅提供了改进的收敛保证和实用的实例化方案，还在不同规模的GPT和LLaMA风格模型上进行了评估。结果显示，TEON能够持续提高训练和验证的困惑度性能，并对近似奇异值分解（SVD）方案具有很高的鲁棒性。
AI.keywords: TEON, Tensorized Orthonormalization, Muon, Large Language Model Pre-Training, Optimizer
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于将梯度正交化的范围从传统的逐层（矩阵级）扩展到了跨层（张量级），从而提出了更具全局视野的优化器TEON。这种张量化方法是Muon优化器的一个重要理论和实践泛化，通过处理高阶张量结构，可能更好地捕捉和协调模型参数之间的复杂依赖关系。此外，TEON在大型语言模型预训练中的持续性能提升和对近似SVD的鲁棒性，表明它是一个有前景的高效优化方案。

title: Particle-Guided Diffusion Models for Partial Differential Equations
summary: We introduce a guided stochastic sampling method that augments sampling from diffusion models with physics-based guidance derived from partial differential equation (PDE) residuals and observational constraints, ensuring generated samples remain physically admissible. We embed this sampling procedure within a new Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) framework, yielding a scalable generative PDE solver. Across multiple benchmark PDE systems as well as multiphysics and interacting PDE systems, our method produces solution fields with lower numerical error than existing state-of-the-art generative methods.

AI.title_translation: 偏微分方程的粒子引导扩散模型
AI.tldr: 提出了一种结合基于物理的指导和序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架的粒子引导扩散模型，用于求解偏微分方程（PDE），该方法是一个可扩展的生成式求解器，且数值误差优于现有最先进的生成方法。
AI.motivation: 开发一个可扩展的生成式偏微分方程（PDE）求解器，并确保扩散模型生成的样本在物理上是可接受的（physically admissible）。
AI.method: 引入了一种引导式随机采样方法，该方法通过偏微分方程（PDE）残差和观测约束导出的基于物理的指导来增强扩散模型的采样，以确保样本符合物理规律。此采样过程被嵌入到一个新的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架中。
AI.result: 在多个基准PDE系统以及多物理场和相互作用的PDE系统中，该方法生成的解场比现有最先进的生成方法具有更低的数值误差。
AI.conclusion: 该方法成功地提供了一个可扩展的生成式偏微分方程（PDE）求解器，在多个基准和复杂系统中，其生成的解场具有比现有最先进的生成方法更低的数值误差。
AI.translation: 我们引入了一种引导式随机采样方法，它使用源自偏微分方程（PDE）残差和观测约束的基于物理的指导来增强扩散模型的采样，确保生成的样本在物理上是可接受的。我们将这种采样过程嵌入到一个新的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架中，从而产生一个可扩展的生成式PDE求解器。在多个基准PDE系统以及多物理场和相互作用的PDE系统中，我们的方法生成的解场具有比现有最先进的生成方法更低的数值误差。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一种粒子引导的扩散模型，该模型通过一种引导式随机采样方法来增强扩散模型的采样，其中集成了源自PDE残差和观测约束的基于物理的指导，以确保样本具有物理可接受性。该采样过程被嵌入到一个新的序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架中，形成一个可扩展的生成式PDE求解器。实验结果表明，该方法在各种复杂PDE系统上的数值误差低于现有最先进的生成方法。
AI.keywords: 扩散模型, 偏微分方程, 序贯蒙特卡洛, 随机采样, 生成式求解器
AI.comments: 该论文的创新点在于将基于物理的指导（源自PDE残差和观测约束）与扩散模型的随机采样过程相结合，确保生成的样本具有物理上的可接受性。通过将这种引导式采样嵌入到序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）框架中，该方法创建了一个可扩展的生成式PDE求解器。这种结合有效地解决了标准生成模型在应用于物理系统时缺乏物理一致性的关键局限性，并且在数值误差方面超越了现有的最先进方法，是生成式PDE求解领域的重要进展。

title: PaperBanana: Automating Academic Illustration for AI Scientists
summary: Despite rapid advances in autonomous AI scientists powered by language models, generating publication-ready illustrations remains a labor-intensive bottleneck in the research workflow. To lift this burden, we introduce PaperBanana, an agentic framework for automated generation of publication-ready academic illustrations. Powered by state-of-the-art VLMs and image generation models, PaperBanana orchestrates specialized agents to retrieve references, plan content and style, render images, and iteratively refine via self-critique. To rigorously evaluate our framework, we introduce PaperBananaBench, comprising 292 test cases for methodology diagrams curated from NeurIPS 2025 publications, covering diverse research domains and illustration styles. Comprehensive experiments demonstrate that PaperBanana consistently outperforms leading baselines in faithfulness, conciseness, readability, and aesthetics. We further show that our method effectively extends to the generation of high-quality statistical plots. Collectively, PaperBanana paves the way for the automated generation of publication-ready illustrations.

AI.title_translation: PaperBanana：为AI科学家自动化生成学术插图
AI.tldr: PaperBanana是一个基于智能体的框架，利用先进的视觉语言模型和图像生成模型，自动化生成高质量、可用于出版的学术插图（包括方法图和统计图），并在专门的基准测试中表现优于现有基线。
AI.motivation: 尽管自主AI科学家取得了快速进展，但生成可用于出版的插图仍然是研究工作流程中耗费人力的瓶颈。
AI.method: 引入PaperBanana，一个代理框架（agentic framework）。它由先进的VLM（视觉语言模型）和图像生成模型驱动，协调专业代理执行：检索参考文献、规划内容和风格、渲染图像，并通过自我批判进行迭代优化。同时，引入PaperBananaBench基准进行评估。
AI.result: PaperBanana在忠实性、简洁性、可读性和美观性方面持续优于领先的基线。该方法还能有效地扩展到生成高质量的统计图。
AI.conclusion: PaperBanana为自动化生成可用于出版的插图铺平了道路。
AI.translation: 尽管自主AI科学家在语言模型的驱动下取得了快速进展，但生成可用于出版的插图仍然是研究工作流程中耗费人力的瓶颈。为了减轻这一负担，我们引入了PaperBanana，一个用于自动化生成可用于出版的学术插图的代理框架。PaperBanana由最先进的VLM和图像生成模型驱动，协调专门的代理来检索参考文献、规划内容和风格、渲染图像，并通过自我批判进行迭代优化。为了严格评估我们的框架，我们引入了PaperBananaBench，它包含292个从NeurIPS 2025出版物中整理出的方法论图表的测试用例，涵盖了不同的研究领域和插图风格。全面的实验表明，PaperBanana在忠实性、简洁性、可读性和美观性方面持续优于领先的基线。我们进一步表明，我们的方法可以有效地扩展到生成高质量的统计图。总而言之，PaperBanana为自动化生成可用于出版的插图铺平了道路。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了PaperBanana，一个用于自动化生成可用于出版的学术插图的代理框架。该框架利用先进的视觉语言模型和图像生成模型，通过专业代理进行内容规划、图像渲染和自我批判迭代优化。为评估PaperBanana，作者构建了包含292个测试用例的PaperBananaBench基准。实验证明，PaperBanana在忠实性、简洁性、可读性和美观性上均优于现有基线，并能有效生成高质量的统计图。
AI.keywords: PaperBanana, 学术插图自动化, 代理框架, VLMs, 图像生成
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于提出了一个端到端、基于智能体的框架（PaperBanana），专门解决学术研究中插图生成的痛点。通过结合VLMs和图像生成模型，并引入自我批判的迭代优化机制，极大地提高了生成插图的质量和专业性。引入的PaperBananaBench基准也为未来该领域的研究提供了一个标准化的评估工具，推动了“自主AI科学家”概念在实际研究工作流程中的落地。

title: IRL-DAL: Safe and Adaptive Trajectory Planning for Autonomous Driving via Energy-Guided Diffusion Models
summary: This paper proposes a novel inverse reinforcement learning framework using a diffusion-based adaptive lookahead planner (IRL-DAL) for autonomous vehicles. Training begins with imitation from an expert finite state machine (FSM) controller to provide a stable initialization. Environment terms are combined with an IRL discriminator signal to align with expert goals. Reinforcement learning (RL) is then performed with a hybrid reward that combines diffuse environmental feedback and targeted IRL rewards. A conditional diffusion model, which acts as a safety supervisor, plans safe paths. It stays in its lane, avoids obstacles, and moves smoothly. Then, a learnable adaptive mask (LAM) improves perception. It shifts visual attention based on vehicle speed and nearby hazards. After FSM-based imitation, the policy is fine-tuned with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). Training is run in the Webots simulator with a two-stage curriculum. A 96\% success rate is reached, and collisions are reduced to 0.05 per 1k steps, marking a new benchmark for safe navigation. By applying the proposed approach, the agent not only drives in lane but also handles unsafe conditions at an expert level, increasing robustness.We make our code publicly available.

AI.title_translation: IRL-DAL：基于能量引导扩散模型的自动驾驶安全自适应轨迹规划
AI.tldr: 提出IRL-DAL，这是一个结合了逆强化学习（IRL）、作为安全监督者的扩散模型以及可学习自适应掩码（LAM）的自动驾驶轨迹规划框架。它使用FSM进行初始化，并用PPO进行微调，在Webots模拟器中实现了96%的成功率，并将碰撞率降至极低，为安全导航树立了新基准。
AI.motivation: 为自动驾驶汽车开发一个安全且鲁棒的轨迹规划框架，该框架能够与专家目标保持一致，并有效处理不安全的驾驶条件。
AI.method: IRL-DAL框架首先通过模仿专家有限状态机（FSM）控制器进行稳定的初始化。它使用结合环境反馈和IRL判别器信号的混合奖励函数。条件扩散模型充当安全监督者，确保路径安全（保持车道、避开障碍物、平稳移动）。此外，引入可学习自适应掩码（LAM）以根据车速和危险调整视觉注意力，从而提高感知能力。策略最终在Webots模拟器中通过两阶段课程使用PPO进行微调。
AI.result: 所提出的方法达到了96%的成功率，并将每1000步的碰撞次数减少到0.05次，为安全导航树立了新的基准。
AI.conclusion: 通过应用所提出的方法，智能体不仅能在车道内行驶，还能以专家级水平处理不安全条件，从而显著提高了鲁棒性。
AI.translation: 本文提出了一种新颖的逆强化学习框架，该框架使用基于扩散的自适应前瞻规划器（IRL-DAL）用于自动驾驶汽车。训练首先从专家有限状态机（FSM）控制器进行模仿，以提供稳定的初始化。环境项与IRL判别器信号相结合，以与专家目标保持一致。随后使用结合了分散环境反馈和目标IRL奖励的混合奖励进行强化学习（RL）。一个充当安全监督者的条件扩散模型规划安全路径。它能保持在车道内、避免障碍物并平稳移动。然后，一个可学习的自适应掩码（LAM）改善了感知能力。它根据车速和附近的危险来转移视觉注意力。在基于FSM的模仿之后，策略通过近端策略优化（PPO）进行微调。训练在Webots模拟器中以两阶段课程运行。该方法达到了96%的成功率，并将每1000步的碰撞次数减少到0.05次，标志着安全导航的新基准。通过应用所提出的方法，智能体不仅能在车道内行驶，还能以专家级水平处理不安全条件，从而提高了鲁棒性。我们公开了代码。
AI.summary: 本文介绍了IRL-DAL，这是一个用于自动驾驶轨迹规划的逆强化学习框架，它集成了条件扩散模型进行安全监督，并使用可学习自适应掩码（LAM）进行自适应感知。该训练流程使用FSM模仿进行初始化，并使用PPO进行微调。该方法在模拟中实现了高成功率和极低的碰撞率，证明了其在处理不安全驾驶场景时的安全性和鲁棒性增强。
AI.keywords: 逆强化学习, 扩散模型, 轨迹规划, 自动驾驶, 安全性
AI.comments: 创新点在于其混合方法：将逆强化学习（IRL）和强化学习（RL）的鲁棒性与扩散模型的生成能力相结合，特别是将扩散模型用作“安全监督者”，这超越了其典型的生成任务应用。可学习自适应掩码（LAM）的引入解决了自适应感知问题，使系统能够关注紧迫的危险。结构化的多阶段训练课程（FSM模仿+PPO微调）对于实现高安全基准至关重要，表明这是一种经过精心设计且稳定的系统。

title: TCBench: A Benchmark for Tropical Cyclone Track and Intensity Forecasting at the Global Scale
summary: TCBench is a benchmark for evaluating global, short to medium-range (1-5 days) forecasts of tropical cyclone (TC) track and intensity. To allow a fair and model-agnostic comparison, TCBench builds on the IBTrACS observational dataset and formulates TC forecasting as predicting the time evolution of an existing tropical system conditioned on its initial position and intensity. TCBench includes state-of-the-art dynamical (TIGGE) and neural weather models (AIFS, Pangu-Weather, FourCastNet v2, GenCast). If not readily available, baseline tracks are consistently derived from model outputs using the TempestExtremes library. For evaluation, TCBench provides deterministic and probabilistic storm-following metrics. On 2023 test cases, neural weather models skillfully forecast TC tracks, while skillful intensity forecasts require additional steps such as post-processing. Designed for accessibility, TCBench helps AI practitioners tackle domain-relevant TC challenges and equips tropical meteorologists with data-driven tools and workflows to improve prediction and TC process understanding. By lowering barriers to reproducible, process-aware evaluation of extreme events, TCBench aims to democratize data-driven TC forecasting.

AI.title_translation: TCBench：全球尺度热带气旋路径和强度预报基准
AI.tldr: TCBench是一个用于评估全球短期（1-5天）热带气旋（TC）路径和强度预报的基准测试平台，它整合了动力学和神经天气模型，并提供了一套标准化的评估指标，旨在推动数据驱动型TC预报的发展。
AI.motivation: 建立一个公平、与模型无关的基准，用于评估全球短期至中期（1-5天）热带气旋（TC）路径和强度的预报能力，旨在帮助AI研究人员应对TC挑战，并为气象学家提供改进预报的数据驱动工具。
AI.method: TCBench基于IBTrACS观测数据集构建，将TC预报表述为预测现有热带系统在初始位置和强度条件下的时间演变。它整合了最新的动力学模型（TIGGE）和神经天气模型（如AIFS、Pangu-Weather），并使用TempestExtremes库从模型输出中一致地导出基线路径。评估采用确定性和概率性的“随风暴移动”（storm-following）指标。
AI.result: 在2023年的测试案例中，神经天气模型能够熟练地预报TC路径，但要想获得熟练的强度预报，则需要额外的步骤，例如后处理。
AI.conclusion: TCBench通过降低可复现、过程感知型极端事件评估的门槛，旨在实现数据驱动型热带气旋预报的民主化，并帮助AI从业者和气象学家改进预报和过程理解。
AI.translation: TCBench是一个用于评估全球短期至中期（1-5天）热带气旋（TC）路径和强度预报的基准测试平台。为了实现公平且与模型无关的比较，TCBench以IBTrACS观测数据集为基础，将TC预报制定为预测现有热带系统在其初始位置和强度条件下的时间演变。TCBench包含了最先进的动力学模型（TIGGE）和神经天气模型（AIFS、盘古气象、FourCastNet v2、GenCast）。如果模型输出中没有现成的路径信息，则使用TempestExtremes库一致地导出基线路径。在评估方面，TCBench提供了确定性和概率性的“随风暴移动”指标。在2023年的测试案例中，神经天气模型能够熟练地预报TC路径，而熟练的强度预报则需要额外的步骤，例如后处理。TCBench的设计注重可及性，旨在帮助AI从业者应对领域相关的TC挑战，并为热带气象学家提供数据驱动的工具和工作流程，以改进预报和对TC过程的理解。通过降低可复现、过程感知型极端事件评估的门槛，TCBench旨在实现数据驱动型TC预报的民主化。
AI.summary: TCBench是一个全球尺度的热带气旋（TC）路径和强度预报基准，专注于1-5天的短期至中期预报。它基于IBTrACS观测数据，统一了动力学和神经天气模型的评估方法（包括TIGGE、Pangu-Weather等）。该基准提供标准化的“随风暴移动”指标，并发现神经模型在路径预报上表现出色，但在强度预报上仍需后处理。TCBench旨在标准化评估流程，促进数据驱动型TC预报的普及和改进。
AI.keywords: 热带气旋预报, 基准测试, 神经天气模型, TC路径和强度, 全球尺度
AI.comments: TCBench的创新性在于创建了一个统一、与模型无关的全球热带气旋（TC）预报基准。它通过整合IBTrACS数据和标准化的评估指标，首次实现了对传统动力学模型（TIGGE）和尖端神经天气模型（如盘古气象）的公平比较。这对加速极端事件预报研究、验证AI在气象学中的实用性至关重要，有助于推动数据驱动型TC预报方法的民主化。

title: Rank Reduction AutoEncoders for Mechanical Design: Advancing Novel and Efficient Data-Driven Topology Optimization
summary: This work presents a data-driven framework for fast forward and inverse analysis in topology optimization (TO) by combining Rank Reduction Autoencoders (RRAEs) with neural latent-space mappings. The methodology targets the efficient approximation of the relationship between optimized geometries and their corresponding mechanical responses or Quantity of Interest (QoI), with a particular focus on compliance-minimized linear elastic structures. High-dimensional TO results are first compressed using RRAEs, which encode the data into a low-rank approximation via Singular Value Decomposition (SVD), obtained in this sense the most important features that approximate the data. Separate RRAE models are trained for geometry and for different types of QoIs, including scalar metrics, one-dimensional stress fields, and full two-dimensional von Mises stress distributions. The resulting low-dimensional latent coefficients of the latent space are then related through multilayer perceptrons to address both direct problems -- predicting structural responses from geometry -- and inverse problems -- recovering geometries from prescribed performance targets. The proposed approach is demonstrated on a benchmark TO problem based on a half MBB beam, using datasets generated via density-based Solid Isotropic Material with Penalization (SIMP) optimization. Numerical results show that the framework enables accurate and computationally efficient surrogate models, with increasing robustness and fidelity as richer QoIs are considered. The methodology also provides a foundation for generative mechanical design by enabling the synthesis of new geometries and responses through latent-space exploration.

AI.title_translation: 机械设计中的降秩自编码器：推进新颖高效的数据驱动拓扑优化
AI.tldr: 使用降秩自编码器（RRAEs）将高维拓扑优化结果压缩到低维潜空间，并利用多层感知器（MLPs）实现快速、准确的正向和逆向机械设计。
AI.motivation: 目标是为拓扑优化（TO）中的快速正向和逆向分析提供一个高效的数据驱动框架，特别是有效逼近优化几何形状与最小化柔度的线性弹性结构的机械响应之间的关系。
AI.method: 结合降秩自编码器（RRAEs，基于SVD）和神经网络（多层感知器，MLPs）。RRAEs用于将高维几何和不同类型的结果量（QoIs，包括标量、一维和二维应力场）压缩到低维潜空间。MLPs用于在潜空间中建立几何与性能之间的映射，以解决正向和逆向问题。方法在半MBB梁基准问题上使用SIMP优化生成的数据集进行了验证。
AI.result: 该框架能够实现准确且计算高效的代理模型。随着考虑更丰富的关注量（QoIs），模型的鲁棒性和保真度有所提高。该方法还支持通过潜空间探索实现新几何形状和响应的合成。
AI.conclusion: 该方法通过创建准确高效的代理模型，推进了新颖高效的数据驱动拓扑优化，并为通过潜空间探索实现生成式机械设计提供了基础。
AI.translation: 这项工作提出了一个数据驱动的框架，通过结合降秩自编码器（RRAEs）和神经潜空间映射，实现拓扑优化（TO）中的快速正向和逆向分析。该方法旨在有效逼近优化几何形状及其相应的机械响应或关注量（QoI）之间的关系，特别关注最小化柔度的线性弹性结构。首先，使用RRAEs压缩高维TO结果，RRAEs通过奇异值分解（SVD）将数据编码为低秩近似，从而获得近似数据的最重要特征。针对几何形状和不同类型的QoIs（包括标量指标、一维应力场和完整的二维冯·米塞斯应力分布），训练了单独的RRAE模型。然后，通过多层感知器将潜空间的低维潜系数关联起来，以解决直接问题（根据几何形状预测结构响应）和逆向问题（根据预设性能目标恢复几何形状）。所提出的方法在一个基于半MBB梁的基准TO问题上得到了验证，使用了通过基于密度的固体各向同性材料惩罚（SIMP）优化生成的数据集。数值结果表明，该框架能够实现准确且计算高效的代理模型，并且随着考虑更丰富的QoIs，其鲁棒性和保真度有所提高。该方法还通过潜空间探索实现新几何形状和响应的合成，为生成式机械设计提供了基础。
AI.summary: 本文提出了一个结合降秩自编码器（RRAEs）和神经网络映射的数据驱动框架，用于拓扑优化（TO）中的快速正向和逆向分析。RRAEs利用奇异值分解（SVD）将高维几何和机械响应（QoIs）高效压缩到低维潜空间。随后，多层感知器将这些潜系数关联起来，以实现从几何到响应的预测（正向）和从性能目标到几何的恢复（逆向）。该方法在MBB梁基准问题上得到验证，结果显示其能生成准确且计算高效的代理模型，并为生成式机械设计奠定了基础。
AI.keywords: 降秩自编码器, 拓扑优化, 数据驱动, 潜空间映射, 生成式设计
AI.comments: **创新点：** 首次将基于奇异值分解（SVD）的降秩自编码器（RRAEs）应用于机械设计数据压缩，特别是对高维拓扑优化几何和完整的应力分布（如二维冯·米塞斯应力）进行高效降维。**重要性：** 该框架通过建立准确且计算高效的代理模型，显著加速了拓扑优化的正向和逆向分析过程，为数据驱动的生成式机械设计提供了强大的基础。此外，通过整合更丰富的关注量（QoIs），模型展示出更高的鲁棒性和保真度。**局限性：** 摘要中未提及明显的局限性，但方法的性能高度依赖于用于训练的SIMP优化数据集的质量和多样性。

title: UPA: Unsupervised Prompt Agent via Tree-Based Search and Selection
summary: Prompt agents have recently emerged as a promising paradigm for automated prompt optimization, framing refinement as a sequential decision-making problem over a structured prompt space. While this formulation enables the use of advanced planning algorithms, these methods typically assume access to supervised reward signals, which are often unavailable in practical scenarios. In this work, we propose UPA, an Unsupervised Prompt Agent that realizes structured search and selection without relying on supervised feedback. Specifically, during search, UPA iteratively constructs an evolving tree structure to navigate the prompt space, guided by fine-grained and order-invariant pairwise comparisons from Large Language Models (LLMs). Crucially, as these local comparisons do not inherently yield a consistent global scale, we decouple systematic prompt exploration from final selection, introducing a two-stage framework grounded in the Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) model. This framework first performs path-wise Bayesian aggregation of local comparisons to filter candidates under uncertainty, followed by global tournament-style comparisons to infer latent prompt quality and identify the optimal prompt. Experiments across multiple tasks demonstrate that UPA consistently outperforms existing prompt optimization methods, showing that agent-style optimization remains highly effective even in fully unsupervised settings.

AI.title_translation: UPA：通过基于树的搜索和选择实现的无监督提示代理
AI.tldr: 提出UPA（无监督提示代理），它使用基于树的搜索和LLM的成对比较，结合BTL模型进行两阶段选择，在没有监督信号的情况下实现了有效的自动化提示优化，并优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有的提示代理（Prompt Agents）范式虽然有前景，但通常需要监督奖励信号，这在实际应用中往往无法获得。因此，需要开发一种在完全无监督环境下仍能有效工作的提示优化方法。
AI.method: 提出UPA，一个两阶段的无监督框架。在搜索阶段，UPA通过迭代构建演化树结构来导航提示空间，并由LLM提供的细粒度、顺序不变的成对比较进行指导。在选择阶段，该框架基于Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) 模型，首先进行路径贝叶斯聚合以过滤候选者，然后进行全局锦标赛式比较以推断潜在提示质量并确定最佳提示。
AI.result: 实验表明，UPA在多项任务上持续优于现有的提示优化方法，证明了代理式优化在完全无监督设置中仍然是高效的。
AI.conclusion: 代理式提示优化在完全无监督的环境下仍然非常有效，UPA通过结合基于树的搜索和基于BTL模型的两阶段选择框架，成功实现了无监督的结构化搜索和优化。
AI.translation: 提示代理最近已成为自动提示优化的一个有前景的范式，它将优化过程构建为结构化提示空间上的序列决策问题。虽然这种公式化方法能够使用先进的规划算法，但这些方法通常假设可以获取监督奖励信号，这在实际场景中往往不可用。在这项工作中，我们提出了UPA，一个无监督提示代理，它无需依赖监督反馈即可实现结构化搜索和选择。具体而言，在搜索过程中，UPA迭代构建一个不断演化的树结构来导航提示空间，并由大型语言模型（LLMs）提供的细粒度且顺序不变的成对比较进行指导。至关重要的是，由于这些局部比较本身不会产生一致的全局尺度，我们引入了一个基于Bradley-Terry-Luce (BTL) 模型的两阶段框架，将系统性的提示探索与最终选择解耦。该框架首先对局部比较进行路径贝叶斯聚合，以在不确定性下过滤候选者，然后进行全局锦标赛式比较，以推断潜在的提示质量并确定最佳提示。跨多项任务的实验表明，UPA持续优于现有的提示优化方法，表明代理式优化即使在完全无监督的设置中仍然非常有效。
AI.summary: 本文提出了UPA（无监督提示代理），旨在解决现有提示优化代理对监督奖励信号的依赖问题。UPA采用基于树的搜索结构，并利用LLM的细粒度成对比较进行指导。为解决局部比较缺乏全局一致性的问题，UPA引入了一个基于BTL模型的两阶段框架：先通过路径贝叶斯聚合过滤候选者，再通过全局锦标赛比较确定最佳提示。实验证明，UPA在无监督环境下能持续超越现有优化方法。
AI.keywords: 无监督提示优化, 提示代理, 基于树的搜索, 成对比较, BTL模型
AI.comments: UPA的创新性在于它成功地将先进的规划代理范式应用于完全无监督的提示优化领域，克服了实际应用中缺乏监督信号的重大障碍。其核心贡献是将LLM的局部、相对比较能力与严谨的统计模型（BTL模型和贝叶斯聚合）相结合，有效地将非一致的局部偏好转化为可靠的全局质量评估。这对于推动LLM在资源受限或难以定义明确奖励函数的环境中的应用具有重要意义。

title: FOCUS: DLLMs Know How to Tame Their Compute Bound
summary: Diffusion Large Language Models (DLLMs) offer a compelling alternative to Auto-Regressive models, but their deployment is constrained by high decoding cost. In this work, we identify a key inefficiency in DLLM decoding: while computation is parallelized over token blocks, only a small subset of tokens is decodable at each diffusion step, causing most compute to be wasted on non-decodable tokens. We further observe a strong correlation between attention-derived token importance and token-wise decoding probability. Based on this insight, we propose FOCUS -- an inference system designed for DLLMs. By dynamically focusing computation on decodable tokens and evicting non-decodable ones on-the-fly, FOCUS increases the effective batch size, alleviating compute limitations and enabling scalable throughput. Empirical evaluations demonstrate that FOCUS achieves up to 3.52$\times$ throughput improvement over the production-grade engine LMDeploy, while preserving or improving generation quality across multiple benchmarks. The FOCUS system is publicly available on GitHub: https://github.com/sands-lab/FOCUS.

AI.title_translation: FOCUS：DLLM 知道如何驯服它们的计算瓶颈
AI.tldr: 扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）因计算浪费而速度慢。FOCUS 是一种新的推理系统，它动态地将计算集中在可解码的 token 上，实时提高有效批处理大小，实现高达 3.52 倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）的部署受到高昂解码成本的限制。主要问题在于，尽管计算是并行化到 token 块上的，但在每个扩散步骤中只有一小部分 token 是可解码的，导致大部分计算浪费在不可解码的 token 上。
AI.method: 观察到注意力衍生的 token 重要性与 token 解码概率之间存在强相关性。基于此，提出了 FOCUS 推理系统，该系统通过动态地将计算集中在可解码的 token 上，并实时驱逐不可解码的 token，从而提高有效批处理大小。
AI.result: 相较于生产级引擎 LMDeploy，FOCUS 实现了高达 3.52 倍的吞吐量提升，同时在多个基准测试中保持或提高了生成质量。
AI.conclusion: FOCUS 系统通过动态聚焦于可解码的 token，有效解决了 DLLM 解码成本高的问题，显著提高了吞吐量并保持了生成质量，从而缓解了计算限制并实现了可扩展的吞吐量。
AI.translation: 扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）提供了一种引人注目的自回归模型的替代方案，但它们的部署受到高昂解码成本的限制。在这项工作中，我们确定了 DLLM 解码中的一个关键低效之处：尽管计算是并行化到 token 块上的，但在每个扩散步骤中只有一小部分 token 是可解码的，导致大部分计算浪费在不可解码的 token 上。我们进一步观察到，注意力衍生的 token 重要性与 token 级别的解码概率之间存在强相关性。基于这一见解，我们提出了 FOCUS——一个专为 DLLMs 设计的推理系统。通过动态地将计算集中在可解码的 token 上，并实时驱逐不可解码的 token，FOCUS 提高了有效批处理大小，从而缓解了计算限制并实现了可扩展的吞吐量。实证评估表明，FOCUS 相较于生产级引擎 LMDeploy，实现了高达 3.52 倍的吞吐量提升，同时在多个基准测试中保持或提高了生成质量。FOCUS 系统已在 GitHub 上公开可用：https://github.com/sands-lab/FOCUS。
AI.summary: 本文提出了 FOCUS，一个专门针对扩散大语言模型（DLLMs）的推理系统，旨在解决其高昂的解码成本。研究人员发现，DLLM 的计算效率低下是由于大部分计算浪费在不可解码的 token 上。FOCUS 利用 token 重要性与解码概率之间的相关性，动态聚焦于可解码 token 并驱逐非可解码 token，从而提高有效批处理大小。实验证明，FOCUS 在保持或提高生成质量的同时，实现了高达 3.52 倍的吞吐量提升。
AI.keywords: 扩散大语言模型, 解码成本, 推理系统, 吞吐量, token 重要性
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于精准识别了 DLLM 解码中的关键效率瓶颈——即计算资源浪费在不可解码的 token 上。FOCUS 系统提出了一种基于注意力衍生的 token 重要性进行动态计算聚焦的实用解决方案。这种方法通过提高有效批处理大小，极大地提升了推理吞吐量（高达 3.52 倍），对于推动 DLLMs 的实际部署具有重要意义。与生产级引擎 LMDeploy 的对比验证了其在实际应用中的有效性。

title: Decoupled Diffusion Sampling for Inverse Problems on Function Spaces
summary: We propose a data-efficient, physics-aware generative framework in function space for inverse PDE problems. Existing plug-and-play diffusion posterior samplers represent physics implicitly through joint coefficient-solution modeling, requiring substantial paired supervision. In contrast, our Decoupled Diffusion Inverse Solver (DDIS) employs a decoupled design: an unconditional diffusion learns the coefficient prior, while a neural operator explicitly models the forward PDE for guidance. This decoupling enables superior data efficiency and effective physics-informed learning, while naturally supporting Decoupled Annealing Posterior Sampling (DAPS) to avoid over-smoothing in Diffusion Posterior Sampling (DPS). Theoretically, we prove that DDIS avoids the guidance attenuation failure of joint models when training data is scarce. Empirically, DDIS achieves state-of-the-art performance under sparse observation, improving $l_2$ error by 11% and spectral error by 54% on average; when data is limited to 1%, DDIS maintains accuracy with 40% advantage in $l_2$ error compared to joint models.

AI.title_translation: 函数空间上逆问题的解耦扩散采样
AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于逆偏微分方程（PDE）问题的解耦扩散生成框架（DDIS）。它通过分离系数先验学习和前向PDE建模，实现了卓越的数据效率和物理感知学习，并在稀疏数据和观测条件下显著优于现有的联合模型。
AI.motivation: 现有的即插即用扩散后验采样器（plug-and-play diffusion posterior samplers）通过联合系数-解建模隐式地表示物理，需要大量的配对监督数据。本文旨在提出一个数据高效、物理感知的生成框架来解决函数空间上的逆PDE问题。
AI.method: 提出解耦扩散逆求解器（DDIS）。它采用解耦设计：一个无条件扩散模型学习系数先验，而一个神经算子显式地建模前向PDE用于指导。该方法还支持解耦退火后验采样（DAPS）以避免扩散后验采样（DPS）中的过平滑问题。
AI.result: 在稀疏观测下实现了最先进的性能，平均$l_2$误差提高了11%，谱误差提高了54%。当数据量限制在1%时，DDIS在$l_2$误差方面比联合模型保持40%的优势。
AI.conclusion: 理论上，DDIS被证明可以避免训练数据稀缺时联合模型的指导衰减失败。经验上，DDIS在数据受限和稀疏观测条件下表现出卓越的准确性和数据效率，显著优于现有联合模型。
AI.translation: 我们提出了一种在函数空间中用于逆偏微分方程（PDE）问题的、数据高效、物理感知的生成框架。现有的即插即用扩散后验采样器通过联合系数-解建模隐式地表示物理，需要大量的配对监督。相比之下，我们的解耦扩散逆求解器（DDIS）采用解耦设计：一个无条件扩散模型学习系数先验，而一个神经算子显式地建模前向PDE用于指导。这种解耦实现了卓越的数据效率和有效的物理感知学习，同时自然地支持解耦退火后验采样（DAPS），以避免扩散后验采样（DPS）中的过平滑问题。理论上，我们证明了当训练数据稀缺时，DDIS避免了联合模型的指导衰减失败。在经验上，DDIS在稀疏观测下实现了最先进的性能，平均$l_2$误差提高了11%，谱误差提高了54%；当数据量限制在1%时，DDIS在$l_2$误差方面比联合模型保持40%的优势。
AI.summary: 本文提出了用于逆PDE问题的解耦扩散逆求解器（DDIS），这是一个数据高效、物理感知的函数空间生成框架。与需要大量配对数据的现有联合建模方法不同，DDIS将系数先验学习（通过无条件扩散）和前向PDE建模（通过神经算子）解耦。这种设计提高了数据效率和物理感知能力，并引入了解耦退火后验采样（DAPS）来解决过平滑问题。DDIS在理论上避免了低数据量下的指导衰减，并在稀疏观测和数据受限（仅1%数据）的实验中，在$l_2$误差和谱误差方面均显著优于联合模型，达到了最先进的性能。
AI.keywords: 扩散采样, 逆问题, 偏微分方程, 函数空间, 解耦设计
AI.comments: 这项工作的创新点在于其“解耦”设计，它解决了现有基于扩散的逆问题求解器在处理稀疏或有限数据时效率低下的关键限制。通过明确地将物理模型（神经算子）与数据驱动的先验学习（无条件扩散）分离，DDIS不仅提高了数据效率，还增强了物理信息在采样过程中的指导作用。理论证明避免了指导衰减，同时显著的经验结果（尤其是在数据量极低时）证明了该方法的实用性和重要性。

title: User Prompting Strategies and Prompt Enhancement Methods for Open-Set Object Detection in XR Environments
comments: Accepted by IEEE VR 2026: GenAI-XR workshop
summary: Open-set object detection (OSOD) localizes objects while identifying and rejecting unknown classes at inference. While recent OSOD models perform well on benchmarks, their behavior under realistic user prompting remains underexplored. In interactive XR settings, user-generated prompts are often ambiguous, underspecified, or overly detailed. To study prompt-conditioned robustness, we evaluate two OSOD models, GroundingDINO and YOLO-E, on real-world XR images and simulate diverse user prompting behaviors using vision-language models. We consider four prompt types: standard, underdetailed, overdetailed, and pragmatically ambiguous, and examine the impact of two enhancement strategies on these prompts. Results show that both models exhibit stable performance under underdetailed and standard prompts, while they suffer degradation under ambiguous prompts. Overdetailed prompts primarily affect GroundingDINO. Prompt enhancement substantially improves robustness under ambiguity, yielding gains exceeding 55% mIoU and 41% average confidence. Based on the findings, we propose several prompting strategies and prompt enhancement methods for OSOD models in XR environments.
comment: Accepted by IEEE VR 2026: GenAI-XR workshop

AI.title_translation: 扩展现实（XR）环境中的开放集目标检测的用户提示策略和提示增强方法
AI.tldr: 研究了在XR环境中，用户提示的质量（标准、细节不足、细节过多、模糊）对开放集目标检测（OSOD）模型（GroundingDINO和YOLO-E）鲁棒性的影响。结果表明，模型在模糊提示下性能急剧下降，但提示增强方法能显著提升鲁棒性（mIoU提高超过55%）。
AI.motivation: 尽管现有的开放集目标检测（OSOD）模型在基准测试中表现良好，但在现实世界的交互式XR设置中，对它们在用户生成的、通常是模糊、细节不足或细节过多的提示下的行为和鲁棒性研究不足。
AI.method: 1. 选取GroundingDINO和YOLO-E两种OSOD模型进行评估。2. 使用真实世界的XR图像。3. 利用视觉-语言模型模拟四种不同的用户提示类型：标准、细节不足、细节过多和语用模糊。4. 检验两种提示增强策略对这些提示的影响。
AI.result: 1. 两种模型在细节不足和标准提示下表现稳定。2. 在模糊提示下，模型性能下降。3. 细节过多的提示主要影响GroundingDINO。4. 提示增强策略能显著提高模型在模糊提示下的鲁棒性，mIoU增益超过55%，平均置信度增益超过41%。
AI.conclusion: 根据研究结果，本文提出了针对XR环境中OSOD模型的几种提示策略和提示增强方法。
AI.translation: 开放集目标检测（OSOD）在定位目标的同时，能够在推理时识别并拒绝未知类别。尽管最近的OSOD模型在基准测试中表现良好，但它们在现实用户提示下的行为仍未得到充分探索。在交互式XR设置中，用户生成的提示通常是模糊、细节不足或细节过多的。为了研究提示条件下的鲁棒性，我们在一组真实世界的XR图像上评估了两种OSOD模型——GroundingDINO和YOLO-E，并使用视觉-语言模型模拟了多样化的用户提示行为。我们考虑了四种提示类型：标准、细节不足、细节过多和语用模糊，并检验了两种增强策略对这些提示的影响。结果显示，两种模型在细节不足和标准提示下表现稳定，但在模糊提示下性能下降。细节过多的提示主要影响GroundingDINO。提示增强策略能大幅提高在模糊情况下的鲁棒性，mIoU增益超过55%，平均置信度增益超过41%。基于这些发现，我们提出了针对XR环境中OSOD模型的几种提示策略和提示增强方法。
AI.summary: 本文旨在研究在交互式XR环境中，不同质量的用户提示对开放集目标检测（OSOD）模型鲁棒性的影响。研究人员使用视觉-语言模型模拟了标准、细节不足、细节过多和语用模糊四种提示类型，并在GroundingDINO和YOLO-E模型上进行了评估。实验发现，模型在模糊提示下性能显著下降，而细节过多的提示主要影响GroundingDINO。通过应用提示增强策略，模型在模糊提示下的鲁棒性得到大幅提升，mIoU和置信度均有显著增长。基于此，论文提出了适用于XR环境的OSOD提示策略和增强方法。
AI.keywords: 开放集目标检测, XR环境, 提示策略, 提示增强, GroundingDINO
AI.comments: 本文解决了在将开放集目标检测（OSOD）技术应用于实际交互式XR系统时面临的一个关键挑战：用户提示的质量和多样性。其创新点在于系统地分类和模拟了现实世界中可能出现的四种用户提示类型，并量化了它们对主流OSOD模型的性能影响。通过引入并验证提示增强策略的有效性（尤其是在模糊提示下超过55%的mIoU提升），该研究为提高OSOD模型在真实用户环境中的实用性和鲁棒性提供了重要的指导和具体的解决方案。这项工作对于推动OSOD从实验室基准走向实际应用具有重要意义。

title: End-to-end Optimization of Belief and Policy Learning in Shared Autonomy Paradigms
summary: Shared autonomy systems require principled methods for inferring user intent and determining appropriate assistance levels. This is a central challenge in human-robot interaction, where systems must be successful while being mindful of user agency. Previous approaches relied on static blending ratios or separated goal inference from assistance arbitration, leading to suboptimal performance in unstructured environments. We introduce BRACE (Bayesian Reinforcement Assistance with Context Encoding), a novel framework that fine-tunes Bayesian intent inference and context-adaptive assistance through an architecture enabling end-to-end gradient flow between intent inference and assistance arbitration. Our pipeline conditions collaborative control policies on environmental context and complete goal probability distributions. We provide analysis showing (1) optimal assistance levels should decrease with goal uncertainty and increase with environmental constraint severity, and (2) integrating belief information into policy learning yields a quadratic expected regret advantage over sequential approaches. We validated our algorithm against SOTA methods (IDA, DQN) using a three-part evaluation progressively isolating distinct challenges of end-effector control: (1) core human-interaction dynamics in a 2D human-in-the-loop cursor task, (2) non-linear dynamics of a robotic arm, and (3) integrated manipulation under goal ambiguity and environmental constraints. We demonstrate improvements over SOTA, achieving 6.3% higher success rates and 41% increased path efficiency, and 36.3% success rate and 87% path efficiency improvement over unassisted control. Our results confirmed that integrated optimization is most beneficial in complex, goal-ambiguous scenarios, and is generalizable across robotic domains requiring goal-directed assistance, advancing the SOTA for adaptive shared autonomy.

AI.title_translation: 共享自主范式中信念与策略学习的端到端优化
AI.tldr: BRACE是一种新型的共享自主框架，通过端到端优化用户意图推断和协助策略，解决了以往方法次优的问题，在复杂机器人任务中显著提高了成功率和效率。
AI.motivation: 共享自主系统需要有原则的方法来推断用户意图并确定适当的协助水平，同时尊重用户的能动性。以往的方法（静态混合比例或分离的意图推断与协助仲裁）在非结构化环境中表现不佳，导致性能次优。
AI.method: 引入了BRACE（具有上下文编码的贝叶斯强化协助）框架。该框架通过一个实现意图推断和协助仲裁之间端到端梯度流的架构，对贝叶斯意图推断和上下文自适应协助进行微调。协作控制策略以环境上下文和完整的（用户）目标概率分布为条件。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，最佳协助水平应随目标不确定性降低而降低，随环境约束严重程度增加而增加。集成优化比顺序方法具有二次方的预期遗憾优势。实验结果显示，BRACE的成功率比SOTA高出6.3%，路径效率提高41%；比无协助控制的成功率提高36.3%，路径效率提高87%。集成优化在复杂、目标模糊的场景中最有益。
AI.conclusion: 信念和策略学习的集成端到端优化（BRACE）提升了自适应共享自主的最新技术水平，并被证实可推广到需要目标导向协助的机器人领域，特别是在复杂、目标模糊的场景中。
AI.translation: 共享自主系统需要有原则的方法来推断用户意图并确定适当的协助水平。这是人机交互中的一个核心挑战，要求系统在成功的同时必须注意用户的能动性。以前的方法依赖于静态混合比例或将目标推断与协助仲裁分离，导致在非结构化环境中的性能次优。我们引入了BRACE（具有上下文编码的贝叶斯强化协助），这是一个新颖的框架，通过一个能够实现意图推断和协助仲裁之间端到端梯度流的架构，对贝叶斯意图推断和上下文自适应协助进行微调。我们的流程将协作控制策略以环境上下文和完整的（用户）目标概率分布为条件。我们提供的分析显示：（1）最佳协助水平应随目标不确定性降低而降低，随环境约束严重程度增加而增加；（2）将信念信息整合到策略学习中比顺序方法具有二次方的预期遗憾优势。我们使用三部分评估（逐步隔离末端执行器控制的不同挑战：(1) 2D人机交互光标任务中的核心人机交互动态，(2) 机械臂的非线性动态，(3) 目标模糊和环境约束下的集成操作）验证了我们的算法与SOTA方法（IDA, DQN）的对比。我们证明了优于SOTA的改进，实现了6.3%更高的成功率和41%更高的路径效率，以及比无协助控制提高36.3%的成功率和87%的路径效率。我们的结果证实，集成优化在复杂、目标模糊的场景中最有益，并且可推广到需要目标导向协助的机器人领域，从而推进了自适应共享自主的SOTA。
AI.summary: BRACE是一种用于共享自主的新型端到端优化框架。它通过整合贝叶斯意图推断和上下文自适应协助，解决了传统方法中意图推断与协助仲裁分离导致的性能次优问题。该框架将控制策略以环境上下文和目标概率分布为条件。理论上，它显示出比顺序方法具有二次方的预期遗憾优势。实验证明，BRACE在多种机器人控制任务中优于现有技术（SOTA），特别是在目标模糊和环境约束复杂的场景中，显著提高了成功率和路径效率。
AI.keywords: 共享自主, 端到端优化, 意图推断, 协助仲裁, 贝叶斯强化学习
AI.comments: 本文的创新点在于连接了信念（意图推断）和策略（协助仲裁）的“端到端梯度流”，而传统方法通常是顺序处理或静态处理的。这种集成优化解决了共享自主中的一个核心限制：实现动态、上下文感知的协助混合。在复杂场景中展示的性能提升（尤其是效率）证实了这种联合学习方法的必要性，使BRACE成为鲁棒人机协作的重大进步。

title: VideoGPA: Distilling Geometry Priors for 3D-Consistent Video Generation
summary: While recent video diffusion models (VDMs) produce visually impressive results, they fundamentally struggle to maintain 3D structural consistency, often resulting in object deformation or spatial drift. We hypothesize that these failures arise because standard denoising objectives lack explicit incentives for geometric coherence. To address this, we introduce VideoGPA (Video Geometric Preference Alignment), a data-efficient self-supervised framework that leverages a geometry foundation model to automatically derive dense preference signals that guide VDMs via Direct Preference Optimization (DPO). This approach effectively steers the generative distribution toward inherent 3D consistency without requiring human annotations. VideoGPA significantly enhances temporal stability, physical plausibility, and motion coherence using minimal preference pairs, consistently outperforming state-of-the-art baselines in extensive experiments.

AI.title_translation: VideoGPA：为3D一致性视频生成蒸馏几何先验
AI.tldr: 为解决视频扩散模型（VDMs）缺乏3D一致性的问题，VideoGPA框架引入了一种自监督方法，利用几何基础模型生成偏好信号，并通过DPO指导VDMs，有效提升了视频的时空连贯性和物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 现有的视频扩散模型（VDMs）在生成视觉效果惊艳的视频时，根本上难以保持3D结构一致性，常导致物体变形或空间漂移，这被认为是标准去噪目标缺乏明确的几何一致性激励所致。
AI.method: VideoGPA是一个数据高效的自监督框架，它利用一个几何基础模型自动推导出密集的偏好信号，并通过直接偏好优化（DPO）来指导视频扩散模型（VDMs），从而将生成分布导向固有的3D一致性。
AI.result: VideoGPA使用最少的偏好对，显著增强了时间稳定性、物理合理性和运动连贯性，并在广泛的实验中持续超越最先进的基线模型。
AI.conclusion: VideoGPA通过利用几何先验，显著提高了视频生成的时间稳定性和物理合理性，并在实验中持续优于现有最先进的方法。
AI.translation: 虽然最近的视频扩散模型（VDMs）产生了视觉上令人印象深刻的结果，但它们在保持3D结构一致性方面存在根本性困难，常常导致物体变形或空间漂移。我们假设这些失败源于标准的去噪目标缺乏对几何一致性的明确激励。为解决这个问题，我们引入了VideoGPA（视频几何偏好对齐），一个数据高效的自监督框架，它利用几何基础模型自动推导出密集的偏好信号，并通过直接偏好优化（DPO）来指导VDMs。这种方法有效地将生成分布引导至固有的3D一致性，而无需人工标注。VideoGPA使用最少的偏好对，显著增强了时间稳定性、物理合理性和运动连贯性，并在广泛的实验中持续超越最先进的基线模型。
AI.summary: VideoGPA是一种创新的、数据高效的自监督框架，旨在解决视频扩散模型（VDMs）在3D结构一致性方面的不足。它通过利用几何基础模型自动生成密集的几何偏好信号，并使用直接偏好优化（DPO）来引导VDMs，从而在无需人工标注的情况下，显著提高了生成视频的时间稳定性和物理合理性。
AI.keywords: 视频生成, 3D一致性, 几何先验, 直接偏好优化, 视频扩散模型
AI.comments: 该方法创新性地利用几何基础模型自动生成偏好信号，并通过DPO引导视频扩散模型，解决了现有VDM在3D一致性方面的核心缺陷，是数据高效且无需人工标注的自监督学习范例。局限性在于其性能依赖于所选几何基础模型的质量。

title: Deep Lightweight Unrolled Network for High Dynamic Range Modulo Imaging
summary: Modulo-Imaging (MI) offers a promising alternative for expanding the dynamic range of images by resetting the signal intensity when it reaches the saturation level. Subsequently, high-dynamic range (HDR) modulo imaging requires a recovery process to obtain the HDR image. MI is a non-convex and ill-posed problem where recent recovery networks suffer in high-noise scenarios. In this work, we formulate the HDR reconstruction task as an optimization problem that incorporates a deep prior and subsequently unrolls it into an optimization-inspired deep neural network. The network employs a lightweight convolutional denoiser for fast inference with minimal computational overhead, effectively recovering intensity values while mitigating noise. Moreover, we introduce the Scaling Equivariance term that facilitates self-supervised fine-tuning, thereby enabling the model to adapt to new modulo images that fall outside the original training distribution. Extensive evaluations demonstrate the superiority of our method compared to state-of-the-art recovery algorithms in terms of performance and quality.

title: Formalization of non-Archimedean functional analysis 1: spherically complete spaces
summary:
In this article, we present a formalization of spherically complete spaces, which is a fundamental notion in non-archimedean functional analysis. This work includes the equivalent definitions of spherically complete spaces, their basic properties, examples and non-examples such as the field $\mathbf{C}_p$ of $p$-adic complex numbers. As applications, we formalize the Birkhoff-James orthogonality, Hahn-Banach extension theorem and the spherical completion for non-archimedean Banach spaces.
  Code available at https://github.com/YijunYuan/SphericalCompleteness

title: UniFinEval: Towards Unified Evaluation of Financial Multimodal Models across Text, Images and Videos
summary: Multimodal large language models are playing an increasingly significant role in empowering the financial domain, however, the challenges they face, such as multimodal and high-density information and cross-modal multi-hop reasoning, go beyond the evaluation scope of existing multimodal benchmarks. To address this gap, we propose UniFinEval, the first unified multimodal benchmark designed for high-information-density financial environments, covering text, images, and videos. UniFinEval systematically constructs five core financial scenarios grounded in real-world financial systems: Financial Statement Auditing, Company Fundamental Reasoning, Industry Trend Insights, Financial Risk Sensing, and Asset Allocation Analysis. We manually construct a high-quality dataset consisting of 3,767 question-answer pairs in both chinese and english and systematically evaluate 10 mainstream MLLMs under Zero-Shot and CoT settings. Results show that Gemini-3-pro-preview achieves the best overall performance, yet still exhibits a substantial gap compared to financial experts. Further error analysis reveals systematic deficiencies in current models. UniFinEval aims to provide a systematic assessment of MLLMs' capabilities in fine-grained, high-information-density financial environments, thereby enhancing the robustness of MLLMs applications in real-world financial scenarios. Data and code are available at https://github.com/aifinlab/UniFinEval.

title: Stablecoin Design with Adversarial-Robust Multi-Agent Systems via Trust-Weighted Signal Aggregation
summary:
Algorithmic stablecoins promise decentralized monetary stability by maintaining a target peg through programmatic reserve management. Yet, their reserve controllers remain vulnerable to regime-blind optimization, calibrating risk parameters on fair-weather data while ignoring tail events that precipitate cascading failures. The March 2020 Black Thursday collapse, wherein MakerDAO's collateral auctions yielded $8.3M in losses and a 15% peg deviation, exposed a critical gap: existing models like SAS systematically omit extreme volatility regimes from covariance estimates, producing allocations optimal in expectation but catastrophic under adversarial stress.
  We present MVF-Composer, a trust-weighted Mean-Variance Frontier reserve controller incorporating a novel Stress Harness for risk-state estimation. Our key insight is deploying multi-agent simulations as adversarial stress-testers: heterogeneous agents (traders, liquidity providers, attackers) execute protocol actions under crisis scenarios, exposing reserve vulnerabilities before they manifest on-chain. We formalize a trust-scoring mechanism T: A -> [0,1] that down-weights signals from agents exhibiting manipulative behavior, ensuring the risk-state estimator remains robust to signal injection and Sybil attacks.
  Across 1,200 randomized scenarios with injected Black-Swan shocks (10% collateral drawdown, 50% sentiment collapse, coordinated redemption attacks), MVF-Composer reduces peak peg deviation by 57% and mean recovery time by 3.1x relative to SAS baselines. Ablation studies confirm the trust layer accounts for 23% of stability gains under adversarial conditions, achieving 72% adversarial agent detection. Our system runs on commodity hardware, requires no on-chain oracles beyond standard price feeds, and provides a reproducible framework for stress-testing DeFi reserve policies.

title: Proliferating series by Jean Barraqué: a study and classification in mathematical terms
summary: Barraqué's proliferating series give an interesting turn on the concept of classic serialism by creating a new invariant when it comes to constructing the series: rather than the intervals between consecutive notes, what remains unaltered during the construction of the proliferations of the given base series is the permutation of the notes which happens between two consecutive series, that is to say, the transformation of the order of the notes in the series. This presents new possibilities for composers interested in the serial method, given the fact that the variety of intervals obtained by this method is far greater than that of classic serialism. In this manuscript, we will study some unexplored possibilities that the proliferating series offer from a mathematical point of view, which will allow composers to gain much more familiarity with them and potentially result in the creation of pieces that take serialism to the next level.

title: SCENE: Semantic-aware Codec Enhancement with Neural Embeddings
summary: Compression artifacts from standard video codecs often degrade perceptual quality. We propose a lightweight, semantic-aware pre-processing framework that enhances perceptual fidelity by selectively addressing these distortions. Our method integrates semantic embeddings from a vision-language model into an efficient convolutional architecture, prioritizing the preservation of perceptually significant structures. The model is trained end-to-end with a differentiable codec proxy, enabling it to mitigate artifacts from various standard codecs without modifying the existing video pipeline. During inference, the codec proxy is discarded, and SCENE operates as a standalone pre-processor, enabling real-time performance. Experiments on high-resolution benchmarks show improved performance over baselines in both objective (MS-SSIM) and perceptual (VMAF) metrics, with notable gains in preserving detailed textures within salient regions. Our results show that semantic-guided, codec-aware pre-processing is an effective approach for enhancing compressed video streams.

title: Practical Evaluation of Quantum Kernel Methods for Radar Micro-Doppler Classification on Noisy Intermediate-Scale Quantum (NISQ) Hardware
summary: This paper examines the application of a Quantum Support Vector Machine (QSVM) for radarbased aerial target classification using micro-Doppler signatures. Classical features are extracted and reduced via Principal Component Analysis (PCA) to enable efficient quantum encoding. The reduced feature vectors are embedded into a quantum kernel-induced feature space using a fully entangled ZZFeatureMap and classified using a kernel based QSVM. Performance is first evaluated on a quantum simulator and subsequently validated on NISQ-era superconducting quantum hardware, specifically the IBM Torino (133-qubit) and IBM Fez (156-qubit) processors. Experimental results demonstrate that the QSVM achieves competitive classification performance relative to classical SVM baselines while operating on substantially reduced feature dimensionality. Hardware experiments reveal the impact of noise and decoherence and measurement shot count on quantum kernel estimation, and further show improved stability and fidelity on newer Heron r2 architecture. This study provides a systematic comparison between simulator-based and hardware-based QSVM implementations and highlights both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying quantum kernel methods for practical radar signal classification tasks.

title: Adaptive Benign Overfitting (ABO): Overparameterized RLS for Online Learning in Non-stationary Time-series
summary: Overparameterized models have recently challenged conventional learning theory by exhibiting improved generalization beyond the interpolation limit, a phenomenon known as benign overfitting. This work introduces Adaptive Benign Overfitting (ABO), extending the recursive least-squares (RLS) framework to this regime through a numerically stable formulation based on orthogonal-triangular updates. A QR-based exponentially weighted RLS (QR-EWRLS) algorithm is introduced, combining random Fourier feature mappings with forgetting-factor regularization to enable online adaptation under non-stationary conditions. The orthogonal decomposition prevents the numerical divergence associated with covariance-form RLS while retaining adaptability to evolving data distributions. Experiments on nonlinear synthetic time series confirm that the proposed approach maintains bounded residuals and stable condition numbers while reproducing the double-descent behavior characteristic of overparameterized models. Applications to forecasting foreign exchange and electricity demand show that ABO is highly accurate (comparable to baseline kernel methods) while achieving speed improvements of between 20 and 40 percent. The results provide a unified view linking adaptive filtering, kernel approximation, and benign overfitting within a stable online learning framework.

title: A Survey on Semantic Communication for Vision: Categories, Frameworks, Enabling Techniques, and Applications
summary: Semantic communication (SemCom) emerges as a transformative paradigm for traffic-intensive visual data transmission, shifting focus from raw data to meaningful content transmission and relieving the increasing pressure on communication resources. However, to achieve SemCom, challenges are faced in accurate semantic quantization for visual data, robust semantic extraction and reconstruction under diverse tasks and goals, transceiver coordination with effective knowledge utilization, and adaptation to unpredictable wireless communication environments. In this paper, we present a systematic review of SemCom for visual data transmission (SemCom-Vision), wherein an interdisciplinary analysis integrating computer vision (CV) and communication engineering is conducted to provide comprehensive guidelines for the machine learning (ML)-empowered SemCom-Vision design. Specifically, this survey first elucidates the basics and key concepts of SemCom. Then, we introduce a novel classification perspective to categorize existing SemCom-Vision approaches as semantic preservation communication (SPC), semantic expansion communication (SEC), and semantic refinement communication (SRC) based on communication goals interpreted through semantic quantization schemes. Moreover, this survey articulates the ML-based encoder-decoder models and training algorithms for each SemCom-Vision category, followed by knowledge structure and utilization strategies. Finally, we discuss potential SemCom-Vision applications.

title: Beyond Conditional Computation: Retrieval-Augmented Genomic Foundation Models with Gengram
summary: Current genomic foundation models (GFMs) rely on extensive neural computation to implicitly approximate conserved biological motifs from single-nucleotide inputs. We propose Gengram, a conditional memory module that introduces an explicit and highly efficient lookup primitive for multi-base motifs via a genomic-specific hashing scheme, establishing genomic "syntax". Integrated into the backbone of state-of-the-art GFMs, Gengram achieves substantial gains (up to 14%) across several functional genomics tasks. The module demonstrates robust architectural generalization, while further inspection of Gengram's latent space reveals the emergence of meaningful representations that align closely with fundamental biological knowledge. By establishing structured motif memory as a modeling primitive, Gengram simultaneously boosts empirical performance and mechanistic interpretability, providing a scalable and biology-aligned pathway for the next generation of GFMs. The code is available at https://github.com/zhejianglab/Genos, and the model checkpoint is available at https://huggingface.co/ZhejiangLab/Gengram.

title: Transitive Sets of Mutually Orthogonal Latin Squares
summary: We investigate MacNeish's conjecture (known to be false in general) in the setting of what we call "transitive" Mutually Orthogonal Latin Squares (MOLS). When we restrict our attention to "simply transitive" MOLS, we find that the conjecture holds. We provide some partial results towards the transitive case, as well as the outcome of a computer search, which introduces a new construction of MOLS. In particular, we were unable to find any transitive large (conjecture-violating) sets of MOLS in the literature.

title: Forecasting in the presence of scale-free noise
comments: 6 pages, 1 figure, 8 sections of Supplementary Information
summary: The extraction of signals from noise is a common problem in all areas of science and engineering. A particularly useful version is that of forecasting: determining a causal filter that estimates a future value of a hidden process from past observations. Current techniques for deriving the filter require that the noise be well described by rational power spectra. However, scale-free noises, whose spectra scale as a non-integer power of frequency, are ubiquitous in practice. We establish a method, together with performance guarantees, that solves the forecasting problem in the presence of scale-free noise. Via the duality between estimation and control, our technique can be used to design control for distributed systems. These results will have wide-ranging applications in neuroscience, finance, fluid dynamics, and quantum measurements.
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 8 sections of Supplementary Information

title: Sylber 2.0: A Universal Syllable Embedding
summary: Scaling spoken language modeling requires speech tokens that are both efficient and universal. Recent work has proposed syllables as promising speech tokens at low temporal resolution, but existing models are constrained to English and fail to capture sufficient acoustic detail. To address this gap, we present Sylber 2.0, a self-supervised framework for coding speech at the syllable level that enables efficient temporal compression and high-fidelity reconstruction. Sylber 2.0 achieves a very low token frequency around 5 Hz, while retaining both linguistic and acoustic detail across multiple languages and expressive styles. Experiments show that it performs on par with previous models operating on high-frequency baselines. Furthermore, Sylber 2.0 enables efficient TTS modeling which can generate speech with competitive intelligibility and quality with SOTA models using only 72M parameters. Moreover, the universality of Sylber 2.0 provides more effective features for low resource ASR than previous speech coding frameworks. In sum, we establish an effective syllable-level abstraction for general spoken language.

title: Dependence-Aware Label Aggregation for LLM-as-a-Judge via Ising Models
summary: Large-scale AI evaluation increasingly relies on aggregating binary judgments from $K$ annotators, including LLMs used as judges. Most classical methods, e.g., Dawid-Skene or (weighted) majority voting, assume annotators are conditionally independent given the true label $Y\in\{0,1\}$, an assumption often violated by LLM judges due to shared data, architectures, prompts, and failure modes. Ignoring such dependencies can yield miscalibrated posteriors and even confidently incorrect predictions. We study label aggregation through a hierarchy of dependence-aware models based on Ising graphical models and latent factors. For class-dependent Ising models, the Bayes log-odds is generally quadratic in votes; for class-independent couplings, it reduces to a linear weighted vote with correlation-adjusted parameters. We present finite-$K$ examples showing that methods based on conditional independence can flip the Bayes label despite matching per-annotator marginals. We prove separation results demonstrating that these methods remain strictly suboptimal as the number of judges grows, incurring nonvanishing excess risk under latent factors. Finally, we evaluate the proposed method on three real-world datasets, demonstrating improved performance over the classical baselines.

title: Quaternionic Perfect Sequences and Hadamard Matrices
summary: A finite sequence of numbers is perfect if it has zero periodic autocorrelation after a nontrivial cyclic shift. In this work, we study quaternionic perfect sequences having a one-to-one correspondence with the binary sequences arising in Williamson's construction of quaternion-type Hadamard matrices. Using this correspondence, we devise an enumeration algorithm that is significantly faster than previously used algorithms and does not require the sequences to be symmetric. We implement our algorithm and use it to enumerate all circulant and possibly non-symmetric Williamson-type matrices of orders up to 21; previously, the largest order exhaustively enumerated was 13. We prove that when the blocks of a quaternion-type Hadamard matrix are circulant, the blocks are necessarily pairwise amicable. This dramatically improves the filtering power of our algorithm: in order 20, the number of block pairs needing consideration is reduced by a factor of over 25,000. We use our results to construct quaternionic Hadamard matrices of interest in quantum communication and prove they are not equivalent to those constructed by other means. We also study the properties of quaternionic Hadamard matrices analytically, and demonstrate the feasibility of characterizing quaternionic Hadamard matrices with a fixed pattern of entries. These results indicate a richer set of properties and suggest an abundance of quaternionic Hadamard matrices for sufficiently large orders.

title: Amortized Simulation-Based Inference in Generalized Bayes via Neural Posterior Estimation
summary: Generalized Bayesian Inference (GBI) tempers a loss with a temperature $β>0$ to mitigate overconfidence and improve robustness under model misspecification, but existing GBI methods typically rely on costly MCMC or SDE-based samplers and must be re-run for each new dataset and each $β$ value. We give the first fully amortized variational approximation to the tempered posterior family $p_β(θ\mid x) \propto π(θ)\,p(x \mid θ)^β$ by training a single $(x,β)$-conditioned neural posterior estimator $q_φ(θ\mid x,β)$ that enables sampling in a single forward pass, without simulator calls or inference-time MCMC. We introduce two complementary training routes: (i) synthesize off-manifold samples $(θ,x) \sim π(θ)\,p(x \mid θ)^β$ and (ii) reweight a fixed base dataset $π(θ)\,p(x \mid θ)$ using self-normalized importance sampling (SNIS). We show that the SNIS-weighted objective provides a consistent forward-KL fit to the tempered posterior with finite weight variance. Across four standard simulation-based inference (SBI) benchmarks, including the chaotic Lorenz-96 system, our $β$-amortized estimator achieves competitive posterior approximations in standard two-sample metrics, matching non-amortized MCMC-based power-posterior samplers over a wide range of temperatures.

title: It's all the (Exponential) Family: An Equivalence between Maximum Likelihood Estimation and Control Variates for Sketching Algorithms
summary: Maximum likelihood estimators (MLE) and control variate estimators (CVE) have been used in conjunction with known information across sketching algorithms and applications in machine learning. We prove that under certain conditions in an exponential family, an optimal CVE will achieve the same asymptotic variance as the MLE, giving an Expectation-Maximization (EM) algorithm for the MLE. Experiments show the EM algorithm is faster and numerically stable compared to other root finding algorithms for the MLE for the bivariate Normal distribution, and we expect this to hold across distributions satisfying these conditions. We show how the EM algorithm leads to reproducibility for algorithms using MLE / CVE, and demonstrate how the EM algorithm leads to finding the MLE when the CV weights are known.

title: Spectral Filtering for Learning Quantum Dynamics
summary: Learning high-dimensional quantum systems is a fundamental challenge that notoriously suffers from the curse of dimensionality. We formulate the task of predicting quantum evolution in the linear response regime as a specific instance of learning a Complex-Valued Linear Dynamical System (CLDS) with sector-bounded eigenvalues -- a setting that also encompasses modern Structured State Space Models (SSMs). While traditional system identification attempts to reconstruct full system matrices (incurring exponential cost in the Hilbert dimension), we propose Quantum Spectral Filtering, a method that shifts the goal to improper dynamic learning. Leveraging the optimal concentration properties of the Slepian basis, we prove that the learnability of such systems is governed strictly by an effective quantum dimension $k^*$, determined by the spectral bandwidth and memory horizon. This result establishes that complex-valued LDSs can be learned with sample and computational complexity independent of the ambient state dimension, provided their spectrum is bounded.

title: Minimal-Action Discrete Schrödinger Bridge Matching for Peptide Sequence Design
summary: Generative modeling of peptide sequences requires navigating a discrete and highly constrained space in which many intermediate states are chemically implausible or unstable. Existing discrete diffusion and flow-based methods rely on reversing fixed corruption processes or following prescribed probability paths, which can force generation through low-likelihood regions and require countless sampling steps. We introduce Minimal-action discrete Schrödinger Bridge Matching (MadSBM), a rate-based generative framework for peptide design that formulates generation as a controlled continuous-time Markov process on the amino-acid edit graph. To yield probability trajectories that remain near high-likelihood sequence neighborhoods throughout generation, MadSBM 1) defines generation relative to a biologically informed reference process derived from pre-trained protein language model logits and 2) learns a time-dependent control field that biases transition rates to produce low-action transport paths from a masked prior to the data distribution. We finally introduce guidance to the MadSBM sampling procedure towards a specific functional objective, expanding the design space of therapeutic peptides; to our knowledge, this represents the first-ever application of discrete classifier guidance to Schrödinger bridge-based generative models.

title: On the computability of cofinal Fraïssé limits
summary:
For any collection of finite structures closed under isomorphism (i.e., an age) which has the Hereditary Property (HP), the Joint Embedding Property (JEP), and the Cofinal Amalgamation Property (CAP), there is a unique (up to isomorphism) countable structure which is cofinally ultrahomogeneous with the given age. Such a structure is called the cofinal Fraïssé limit of the age.
  In this paper, we consider the computational strength needed to construct the cofinal Fraïssé limit of a computable age. We show that this construction can always be done using the oracle 0''', and that there are ages that require 0''.
  In contrast, we show that if one assumes the strengthening of (CAP) known as the Amalgamation Property (AP), then the resulting limit, called the Fraïssé limit, can be constructed from the age using 0'. Our results therefore show that the more general case of cofinal Fraïssé limits requires greater computational strength than Fraïssé limits.

title: Simulation-based Bayesian inference with ameliorative learned summary statistics -- Part I
summary: This paper, which is Part 1 of a two-part paper series, considers a simulation-based inference with learned summary statistics, in which such a learned summary statistic serves as an empirical-likelihood with ameliorative effects in the Bayesian setting, when the exact likelihood function associated with the observation data and the simulation model is difficult to obtain in a closed form or computationally intractable. In particular, a transformation technique which leverages the Cressie-Read discrepancy criterion under moment restrictions is used for summarizing the learned statistics between the observation data and the simulation outputs, while preserving the statistical power of the inference. Here, such a transformation of data-to-learned summary statistics also allows the simulation outputs to be conditioned on the observation data, so that the inference task can be performed over certain sample sets of the observation data that are considered as an empirical relevance or believed to be particular importance. Moreover, the simulation-based inference framework discussed in this paper can be extended further, and thus handling weakly dependent observation data. Finally, we remark that such an inference framework is suitable for implementation in distributed computing, i.e., computational tasks involving both the data-to-learned summary statistics and the Bayesian inferencing problem can be posed as a unified distributed inference problem that will exploit distributed optimization and MCMC algorithms for supporting large datasets associated with complex simulation models.

title: AI Decodes Historical Chinese Archives to Reveal Lost Climate History
comments: 60 pages, 4 figures in the main text, 25 figures and 10 tables in the appendix
summary: Historical archives contain qualitative descriptions of climate events, yet converting these into quantitative records has remained a fundamental challenge. Here we introduce a paradigm shift: a generative AI framework that inverts the logic of historical chroniclers by inferring the quantitative climate patterns associated with documented events. Applied to historical Chinese archives, it produces the sub-annual precipitation reconstruction for southeastern China over the period 1368-1911 AD. Our reconstruction not only quantifies iconic extremes like the Ming Dynasty's Great Drought but also, crucially, maps the full spatial and seasonal structure of El Ni$ñ$o influence on precipitation in this region over five centuries, revealing dynamics inaccessible in shorter modern records. Our methodology and high-resolution climate dataset are directly applicable to climate science and have broader implications for the historical and social sciences.
comment: 60 pages, 4 figures in the main text, 25 figures and 10 tables in the appendix

title: On the undecidability of quantum channel capacities
summary: An important distinction in our understanding of capacities of classical versus quantum channels is marked by the following question: is there an algorithm which can compute (or even efficiently compute) the capacity? While there is overwhelming evidence suggesting that quantum channel capacities may be uncomputable, a formal proof of any such statement is elusive. We initiate the study of the hardness of computing quantum channel capacities. We show that, for a general quantum channel, it is QMA-hard to compute its quantum capacity, and that the maximal-entanglement-assisted zero-error one-shot classical capacity is uncomputable.

title: Structural Conditions for Native CCZ Magic-State Fountains in qLDPC Codes
summary:
Quantum low-density parity-check (qLDPC) codes promise constant-rate, linear-distance families with bounded-weight checks, and recent work has realized transversal or constant-depth non-Clifford gates on various (often non-LDPC) codes. However, no explicit \emph{qubit} qLDPC family is known that simultaneously has constant rate, linear distance, bounded stabilizer weight, and a native \emph{magic-state fountain} that prepares many non-Clifford resource states in constant depth.
  We take a structural approach and identify coding-theoretic conditions under which a CSS qLDPC family necessarily supports a constant-depth $\CCZ$ magic-state fountain. The key ingredients are: (i) an algebraic notion of \emph{magic-friendly triples} of $X$-type logical operators, defined by pairwise orthogonality and a triple-overlap form controlling diagonal $\CCZ$ phases, and (ii) a 3-uniform hypergraph model of physical $\CCZ$ circuits combined with a packing lemma that turns large collections of such triples with bounded overlaps into bounded-degree hypergraphs.
  Our main theorem shows that if a CSS code family on $n$ qubits admits $Ω(n^{1+γ})$ magic-friendly triples whose supports have bounded per-qubit participation, then there exists a constant-depth circuit of physical $\CCZ$ gates implementing $Ω(n^γ)$ logical $\CCZ$ gates in parallel while preserving distance up to a constant factor. For asymptotically good qLDPC families such as quantum Tanner codes, this reduces the existence of a native $\CCZ$ magic-state fountain to a concrete combinatorial problem about counting and distributing magic-friendly triples in the logical $X$ space.

title: Corrected Samplers for Discrete Flow Models
summary: Discrete flow models (DFMs) have been proposed to learn the data distribution on a finite state space, offering a flexible framework as an alternative to discrete diffusion models. A line of recent work has studied samplers for discrete diffusion models, such as tau-leaping and Euler solver. However, these samplers require a large number of iterations to control discretization error, since the transition rates are frozen in time and evaluated at the initial state within each time interval. Moreover, theoretical results for these samplers often require boundedness conditions of the transition rate or they focus on a specific type of source distributions. To address those limitations, we establish non-asymptotic discretization error bounds for those samplers without any restriction on transition rates and source distributions, under the framework of discrete flow models. Furthermore, by analyzing a one-step lower bound of the Euler sampler, we propose two corrected samplers: \textit{time-corrected sampler} and \textit{location-corrected sampler}, which can reduce the discretization error of tau-leaping and Euler solver with almost no additional computational cost. We rigorously show that the location-corrected sampler has a lower iteration complexity than existing parallel samplers. We validate the effectiveness of the proposed method by demonstrating improved generation quality and reduced inference time on both simulation and text-to-image generation tasks. Code can be found in https://github.com/WanZhengyan/Corrected-Samplers-for-Discrete-Flow-Models.

title: EndoCaver: Handling Fog, Blur and Glare in Endoscopic Images via Joint Deblurring-Segmentation
comments: Accepted for publication at IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026
summary: Endoscopic image analysis is vital for colorectal cancer screening, yet real-world conditions often suffer from lens fogging, motion blur, and specular highlights, which severely compromise automated polyp detection. We propose EndoCaver, a lightweight transformer with a unidirectional-guided dual-decoder architecture, enabling joint multi-task capability for image deblurring and segmentation while significantly reducing computational complexity and model parameters. Specifically, it integrates a Global Attention Module (GAM) for cross-scale aggregation, a Deblurring-Segmentation Aligner (DSA) to transfer restoration cues, and a cosine-based scheduler (LoCoS) for stable multi-task optimisation. Experiments on the Kvasir-SEG dataset show that EndoCaver achieves 0.922 Dice on clean data and 0.889 under severe image degradation, surpassing state-of-the-art methods while reducing model parameters by 90%. These results demonstrate its efficiency and robustness, making it well-suited for on-device clinical deployment. Code is available at https://github.com/ReaganWu/EndoCaver.
comment: Accepted for publication at IEEE International Conference on Acoustics, Speech and Signal Processing (ICASSP) 2026

title: Bonnet: Ultra-fast whole-body bone segmentation from CT scans
comments: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2026)
summary: This work proposes Bonnet, an ultra-fast sparse-volume pipeline for whole-body bone segmentation from CT scans. Accurate bone segmentation is important for surgical planning and anatomical analysis, but existing 3D voxel-based models such as nnU-Net and STU-Net require heavy computation and often take several minutes per scan, which limits time-critical use. The proposed Bonnet addresses this by integrating a series of novel framework components including HU-based bone thresholding, patch-wise inference with a sparse spconv-based U-Net, and multi-window fusion into a full-volume prediction. Trained on TotalSegmentator and evaluated without additional tuning on RibSeg, CT-Pelvic1K, and CT-Spine1K, Bonnet achieves high Dice across ribs, pelvis, and spine while running in only 2.69 seconds per scan on an RTX A6000. Compared to strong voxel baselines, Bonnet attains a similar accuracy but reduces inference time by roughly 25x on the same hardware and tiling setup. The toolkit and pre-trained models will be released at https://github.com/HINTLab/Bonnet.
comment: 5 pages, 2 figures. Accepted for publication at the 2026 IEEE International Symposium on Biomedical Imaging (ISBI 2026)

title: An Efficient Algorithm for Thresholding Monte Carlo Tree Search
summary: We introduce the Thresholding Monte Carlo Tree Search problem, in which, given a tree $\mathcal{T}$ and a threshold $θ$, a player must answer whether the root node value of $\mathcal{T}$ is at least $θ$ or not. In the given tree, `MAX' or `MIN' is labeled on each internal node, and the value of a `MAX'-labeled (`MIN'-labeled) internal node is the maximum (minimum) of its child values. The value of a leaf node is the mean reward of an unknown distribution, from which the player can sample rewards. For this problem, we develop a $δ$-correct sequential sampling algorithm based on the Track-and-Stop strategy that has asymptotically optimal sample complexity. We show that a ratio-based modification of the D-Tracking arm-pulling strategy leads to a substantial improvement in empirical sample complexity, as well as reducing the per-round computational cost from linear to logarithmic in the number of arms.

title: RPWithPrior: Label Differential Privacy in Regression
summary: With the wide application of machine learning techniques in practice, privacy preservation has gained increasing attention. Protecting user privacy with minimal accuracy loss is a fundamental task in the data analysis and mining community. In this paper, we focus on regression tasks under $ε$-label differential privacy guarantees. Some existing methods for regression with $ε$-label differential privacy, such as the RR-On-Bins mechanism, discretized the output space into finite bins and then applied RR algorithm. To efficiently determine these finite bins, the authors rounded the original responses down to integer values. However, such operations does not align well with real-world scenarios. To overcome these limitations, we model both original and randomized responses as continuous random variables, avoiding discretization entirely. Our novel approach estimates an optimal interval for randomized responses and introduces new algorithms designed for scenarios where a prior is either known or unknown. Additionally, we prove that our algorithm, RPWithPrior, guarantees $ε$-label differential privacy. Numerical results demonstrate that our approach gets better performance compared with the Gaussian, Laplace, Staircase, and RRonBins, Unbiased mechanisms on the Communities and Crime, Criteo Sponsored Search Conversion Log, California Housing datasets.

title: Training Beyond Convergence: Grokking nnU-Net for Glioma Segmentation in Sub-Saharan MRI
summary: Gliomas are placing an increasingly clinical burden on Sub-Saharan Africa (SSA). In the region, the median survival for patients remains under two years, and access to diagnostic imaging is extremely limited. These constraints highlight an urgent need for automated tools that can extract the maximum possible information from each available scan, tools that are specifically trained on local data, rather than adapted from high-income settings where conditions are vastly different. We utilize the Brain Tumor Segmentation (BraTS) Africa 2025 Challenge dataset, an expert annotated collection of glioma MRIs. Our objectives are: (i) establish a strong baseline with nnUNet on this dataset, and (ii) explore whether the celebrated "grokking" phenomenon an abrupt, late training jump from memorization to superior generalization can be triggered to push performance without extra labels. We evaluate two training regimes. The first is a fast, budget-conscious approach that limits optimization to just a few epochs, reflecting the constrained GPU resources typically available in African institutions. Despite this limitation, nnUNet achieves strong Dice scores: 92.3% for whole tumor (WH), 86.6% for tumor core (TC), and 86.3% for enhancing tumor (ET). The second regime extends training well beyond the point of convergence, aiming to trigger a grokking-driven performance leap. With this approach, we were able to achieve grokking and enhanced our results to higher Dice scores: 92.2% for whole tumor (WH), 90.1% for tumor core (TC), and 90.2% for enhancing tumor (ET).

title: Generative and Nonparametric Approaches for Conditional Distribution Estimation: Methods, Perspectives, and Comparative Evaluations
summary: The inference of conditional distributions is a fundamental problem in statistics, essential for prediction, uncertainty quantification, and probabilistic modeling. A wide range of methodologies have been developed for this task. This article reviews and compares several representative approaches spanning classical nonparametric methods and modern generative models. We begin with the single-index method of Hall and Yao (2005), which estimates the conditional distribution through a dimension-reducing index and nonparametric smoothing of the resulting one-dimensional cumulative conditional distribution function. We then examine the basis-expansion approaches, including FlexCode (Izbicki and Lee, 2017) and DeepCDE (Dalmasso et al., 2020), which convert conditional density estimation into a set of nonparametric regression problems. In addition, we discuss two recent generative simulation-based methods that leverage modern deep generative architectures: the generative conditional distribution sampler (Zhou et al., 2023) and the conditional denoising diffusion probabilistic model (Fu et al., 2024; Yang et al., 2025).
